units.zh: 言之不從，是謂不乂
units.en: When commands find no compliance, the canon calls it a failure of proper order.
units.literal: When commands find no compliance, the canon calls it a failure of proper order.

units.zh: 《傳》曰：「言之不從，是謂不乂，厥咎僭，厥罰恆陽，厥極憂。
units.en: The tradition reads: when the ruler's word is not heeded, that is "disorder of governance"; the blame falls on arrogance, the chastisement takes the form of unrelenting drought, and the worst reach is widespread anxiety.
units.literal: The tradition reads: when the ruler's word is not heeded, that is "disorder of governance"; the blame falls on arrogance, the chastisement takes the form of unrelenting drought, and the worst reach is widespread anxiety.

units.zh: 時則有詩妖，時則有介蟲之孽，時則有犬禍，時則有口舌之痾，時則有白眚白祥。
units.en: At such times there are omens in songs; at such times calamities from shelled insects; at such times dog disasters; at such times afflictions of mouth and tongue; at such times white ill-omens and white auspicious signs.
units.literal: At such times there are omens in songs; at such times calamities from shelled insects; at such times dog disasters; at such times afflictions of mouth and tongue; at such times white ill-omens and white auspicious signs.

units.zh: 惟木沴金。」
units.en: Only Wood harms Metal."
units.literal: Only Wood harms Metal."

units.zh: 言之不從，從，順也。
units.en: The gloss defines "not following" as a refusal to go along with what was commanded.
units.literal: If words are not followed" — "follow" means accord and compliance.

units.zh: 是謂不乂，乂，治也。
units.en: They label it a breakdown of rule itself, for the graph glossed as "to govern" is precisely to set the realm to rights.
units.literal: This is called "not governing"; the gloss "govern" (yi) means to put in order.

units.zh: 孔子曰：「君子居其室，出其言不善，則千里之外違之，況其邇者乎！」
units.en: Confucius said: "The gentleman sits in his chamber; if the words he utters are not good, they are rejected a thousand li away — how much more by those nearby!"
units.literal: Confucius said: "The gentleman sits in his chamber; if the words he utters are not good, they are rejected a thousand li away — how much more by those nearby!"

units.zh: 《詩》曰：「如蜩如螗，如沸如羹。」
units.en: The Book of Songs says: "Like cicadas, like cicadas; like boiling, like a stew."
units.literal: The Book of Songs says: "Like cicadas, like cicadas; like boiling, like a stew."

units.zh: 言上號令不順人心，虛譁憒亂，則不能治海內。
units.en: The point is that edicts which cut against the people produce empty noise and panic until the land can no longer be ruled.
units.literal: It means that when superiors' commands do not accord with human hearts, hollow uproar and confusion arise, and the seas (the realm) cannot be governed.

units.zh: 失在過差，故其咎僭差也。
units.en: The misstep is overreach and skewed judgment, which the text names as usurpation and disorder.
units.literal: The failure lies in excess and error; therefore the fault is presumption and deviance.

units.zh: 刑罰妄加，群陰不附，則陽氣勝，故其罰常陽也。
units.en: Wanton penalties drive loyal ministers away, yang energy runs unchecked, and the heaven-sent scourge appears as relentless drought and searing heat.
units.literal: When punishments are applied without cause and the many yin forces will not cleave, yang qi prevails; therefore the punishment is "constant yang."

units.zh: 旱傷百穀，則有寇難，上下俱憂，故其極憂也。
units.en: Crops wither, invaders press in, court and countryside share dread — that is the nadir called "anxiety."
units.literal: Drought injures the hundred grains; there are raids and hardship; high and low alike are anxious — therefore the extreme is worry.

units.zh: 君炕陽而暴虐，臣畏刑而箝口，則怨謗之氣發於歌謠，故有詩妖。
units.en: A brutal sovereign and a silenced bureaucracy turn popular ballads into vessels of grievance, which is what the canon means by "song omens."
units.literal: When the ruler oppresses with cruel yang-like force and ministers fear the penal code and seal their lips, resentful slander vents itself in songs — therefore there are omens in verse.

units.zh: 介蟲孽者，謂小蟲有甲飛揚之類，陽氣所生也，於《春秋》為螽，今謂之蝗，皆其類也。
units.en: Armored vermin — winged pests bred of excess yang — match the spring-and-autumn record of locust plagues.
units.literal: Calamity from "intermediate insects" means small creatures with shell or wing that swarm aloft; they are born of yang qi; in the Spring and Autumn Annals they are called zhong; today we call them locusts — all one class.

units.zh: 于《易》，《兌》為口，犬以吠守而不可信，言氣毀，故有犬禍。
units.en: The hexagram Dui governs utterance; dogs figure betrayal masquerading as vigilance, so corrupt words invite canine portents.
units.literal: In the Changes, Dui stands for the mouth; dogs bark to guard yet are untrustworthy; speech and breath are ruined — therefore there are dog disasters.

units.zh: 一曰，旱歲犬多狂死及為怪，亦是也。
units.en: Another gloss counts rabid dogs and dog-shaped freaks in parched seasons as the same sign.
units.literal: One view adds: in drought years many dogs go mad, die, or behave as monsters — that also applies.

units.zh: 及人，則多病口喉咳嗽者，故有口舌痾。
units.en: Among men it shows as oral and throat diseases and hacking coughs.
units.literal: When it reaches people, many fall ill in mouth, throat, and cough — therefore there are afflictions of mouth and tongue.

units.zh: 金色白，故有白眚白祥。
units.en: Because metal correlates with white, pale anomalies in heaven and earth follow.
units.literal: Metal's color is white — therefore there are white ill-omens and white signs.

units.zh: 凡言傷者，病金氣；
units.en: Each mention of "harm" targets the metal element in the cosmic scheme.
units.literal: Whenever the text speaks of "injury," it means harm to the Metal phase.

units.zh: 金氣病，則木沴之。
units.en: A sick metal phase draws the countering force of wood.
units.literal: When Metal is diseased, Wood harms (overwhelms) it.

units.zh: 其極憂者，順之，其福曰康寧。
units.en: Redress that worst anxiety with obedience, and the promised fortune is tranquility and well-being.
units.literal: For the extreme of worry, if treated with compliance, the blessing is called "peace and health."

units.zh: 劉歆《言傳》曰時則有毛蟲之孽。
units.en: Liu Xin adds omens from furry pests to the catalogue.
units.literal: Liu Xin's Treatise on Words says: at such times there are calamities from hairy creatures.

units.zh: 說以為于天文西方參為獸星，故為毛蟲。
units.en: Commentators link the omen to the western mansion Shen, the astral seat of beasts.
units.literal: The gloss holds that in astronomy the western constellation Shen is the "beast" star — hence hairy creatures.

units.zh: 魏齊王嘉平初，東郡有訛言，云白馬河出妖馬，夜過官牧邊鳴呼，眾馬皆應，明日見其跡，大如斛，行數里，還入河。
units.en: In Cao Fang's Jiaping years Dongjun buzzed with talk of a monstrous horse from the White Horse River that neighed along the government stud by night and left tracks like vats before vanishing upstream.
units.literal: Early in the Jiaping era of the Wei "Qi King," Dong commandery had a rumor that a demon horse had emerged from the Baima River; by night it passed the border of the official pasture neighing, and all horses answered; the next day tracks were seen, as large as a hu measure, running several li, then returning into the river.

units.zh: 楚王彪本封白馬，兗州刺史令狐愚以彪有智勇，及聞此言，遂與王淩謀共立之。
units.en: Cao Biao, once prince at Baima, seemed to Linghu Yu a bold candidate for the throne, so the inspector joined Wang Ling's plot to enthrone him.
units.literal: Prince Chu, Cao Biao, had originally been enfeoffed at Baima; Yanzhou inspector Linghu Yu, considering Biao wise and brave, on hearing this story then conspired with Wang Ling jointly to elevate him.

units.zh: 事泄，淩、愚被誅，彪賜死。
units.en: Discovery brought down Wang Ling and Linghu Yu, and Cao Biao was forced to kill himself.
units.literal: The affair leaked; Ling and Yu were executed, and Biao was sentenced to suicide.

units.zh: 此言不從之罰也。
units.en: It illustrates heaven's rebuke when men ignore what prudence should have told them.
units.literal: This was the punishment for words not being heeded.

units.zh: 《詩》云：「人之訛言，甯莫之懲。」
units.en: The Book of Songs says: "Because of people's false rumors — will no one chastise them?"
units.literal: The Book of Songs says: "Because of people's false rumors — will no one chastise them?"

units.zh: 蜀劉禪嗣位，譙周曰：「先主諱備，其訓具也，後主諱禪，其訓授也。
units.en: In Shu, when Liu Shan succeeded, Qiao Zhou said: "The late founder's taboo name was Bei, glossed 'complete'; the reigning lord's taboo name is Shan, glossed 'to hand over.
units.literal: In Shu, when Liu Shan succeeded, Qiao Zhou said: "The late founder's taboo name was Bei, glossed 'complete'; the reigning lord's taboo name is Shan, glossed 'to hand over.

units.zh: 若言劉已具矣，當授與人，甚于晉穆侯、漢靈帝命子之祥也。」
units.en: If it means the Liu house was already "complete" and ought to be "handed over" to another, that is a graver omen than Jin Marquis Mu's naming of his heir or Han Emperor Ling's choice of heir."
units.literal: If it means the Liu house was already "complete" and ought to be "handed over" to another, that is a graver omen than Jin Marquis Mu's naming of his heir or Han Emperor Ling's choice of heir."

units.zh: 蜀果亡，此言之不從也。
units.en: Shu fell soon after, proving the saying about unruly speech.
units.literal: Shu indeed perished — this was heedlessness of words.

units.zh: 劉備卒，劉禪即位，未葬，亦未逾月，而改元為建興，此言之不從也。
units.en: Liu Bei died; Liu Shan mounted the throne; before the burial, before a month had passed, he changed the era name to Jianxing — another breach of what ritual language allowed.
units.literal: Liu Bei died; Liu Shan mounted the throne; before the burial, before a month had passed, he changed the era name to Jianxing — this was heedlessness of words.

units.zh: 禮，國君即位逾年而後改元者，緣臣子之心不忍一年而有二君。
units.en: Propriety defers the new era name so ministers need not acknowledge two sovereign anniversaries within a single cycle.
units.literal: By ritual, a state lord waits a full year after accession before changing the era name, because the hearts of subjects cannot bear two rulers in one year.

units.zh: 今可謂亟而不知禮義矣。
units.en: His haste showed contempt for the decencies that bind a crown prince.
units.literal: This may be called hasty ignorance of ritual and righteousness.

units.zh: 後遂降焉。
units.en: In the end he capitulated to Wei.
units.literal: Later he indeed surrendered.

units.zh: 魏明帝太和中，姜維歸蜀，失其母。
units.en: While Ming-di of Wei reigned, Jiang Wei defected to Shu and lost touch with his mother.
units.literal: In Wei Emperor Ming's Taihe years, Jiang Wei went over to Shu and was separated from his mother.

units.zh: 魏人使其母手書呼維令反，並送當歸以譬之。
units.en: Wei officials made her pen an appeal for his return and boxed the herb angelica as a pun on "coming home."
units.literal: The Wei authorities had her write in her own hand urging Wei to rebel, and also sent the herb danggui ("return-home" angelica) as a metaphor.

units.zh: 維報書曰：「良田百頃，不計一畝，但見遠志，無有當歸。」
units.en: Jiang Wei replied in writing: "Of a hundred qing of good fields I count not one mu — I only see 'far ambition' (a herb name); there is no 'return-home' (angelica)."
units.literal: Jiang Wei replied in writing: "Of a hundred qing of good fields I count not one mu — I only see 'far ambition' (a herb name); there is no 'return-home' (angelica)."

units.zh: 維卒不免。
units.en: In the end Jiang Wei could not escape his fate.
units.literal: In the end Jiang Wei could not escape his fate.

units.zh: 景初元年，有司奏，帝為烈祖，與太祖、高祖並為不毀之廟，從之。
units.en: In the first Jingchu year, the authorities memorialized that the emperor be titled Liezu and share, with Taizu and Gaozu, temples that would not be destroyed — and the court assented.
units.literal: In the first Jingchu year, the authorities memorialized that the emperor be titled Liezu and share, with Taizu and Gaozu, temples that would never be dismantled; the throne agreed.

units.zh: 案宗廟之制，祖宗之號，皆身沒名成乃正其禮。
units.en: Temple law defers a deified style until the ruler is dead and his renown fixed.
units.literal: By ancestral-temple precedent, titles for remote forebears are fixed only after death, when the name is fully settled.

units.zh: 故雖功赫天壤，德邁前王，未有豫定之典。
units.en: No greatness, however cosmic, justifies crowning the honor while the man still breathes.
units.literal: Therefore even merit that shakes heaven and earth and virtue surpassing former kings has no rule allowing advance fixing.

units.zh: 此蓋言之不從失之甚者也。
units.en: It stands among the clearest cases where rhetoric outran ritual propriety.
units.literal: This was perhaps the most extreme failure of language to stay within due bounds.

units.zh: 後二年而宮車晏駕，於是統微政逸。
units.en: Within two years Ming-di was dead; thereafter authority thinned and policy slid into slackness.
units.literal: Two years later the imperial carriage halted forever; then the ruling line weakened and administration drifted.

units.zh: 吳孫休時，烏程人有得困病，及差，能以響言者，言于此而聞於彼。
units.en: During Sun Xiu's reign a Wucheng convalescent acquired ventriloquy that carried his voice miles from his lips.
units.literal: Under Wu's Sun Xiu, a man of Wucheng fell deathly ill; after he recovered he could "resounding-speak" — speak here and be heard there.

units.zh: 自其所聽之，不覺其聲之大也。
units.en: Beside him it sounded no louder than ordinary speech.
units.literal: From the listener's own place he did not notice the sound as particularly loud.

units.zh: 自遠聽之，如人對言，不覺聲之自遠來也。
units.en: From afar it seemed like conversation at arm's length, with no hint of distant projection.
units.literal: From a distance it was like face-to-face talk; one did not sense that the voice came from far away.

units.zh: 聲之所往，隨其所向，遠者所過十數里。
units.en: He could steer the voice through a dozen leagues or more.
units.literal: The sound went wherever he aimed it; those farthest heard it across more than ten li.

units.zh: 其鄰人有責息于外，歷年不還，乃假之使為責讓，懼以禍福。
units.en: A creditor used him to haunt a defaulter abroad with ghostly threats of blessing or woe.
units.literal: A neighbor had money lent abroad that went unreturned for years; he borrowed the gift to have him deliver rebukes, threatening fortune or calamity.

units.zh: 負物者以為鬼神，即傎倒畀之，其人亦不自知所以然也。
units.en: The frightened borrower paid in full at once, while the wonder-worker himself hardly grasped the trick.
units.literal: The debtor took it for a spirit, immediately turned everything over in payment; that man also did not know why it happened thus.

units.zh: 言不從之咎也。
units.en: The historians filed it under portents of distorted speech.
units.literal: This was a fault arising from words not following their proper course.

units.zh: 魏時起安世殿，武帝后居之。
units.en: Wei builders raised Anshi Hall, later occupied by Sima Yan's empress.
units.literal: In Wei they built Anshi Hall; later the empress of Emperor Wu resided there.

units.zh: 安世，武帝字也。
units.en: The hall bore Sima Yan's childhood name, Anshi.
units.literal: Anshi was Emperor Wu's courtesy name.

units.zh: 武帝每延群臣，多說平生常事，未嘗及經國遠圖。
units.en: At court he dwelt on small talk, never on how to steer the empire.
units.literal: Whenever Emperor Wu extended audiences to ministers he spoke mostly of trivial personal matters and never touched long-term state plans.

units.zh: 此言之不從也。
units.en: It marked another omen of rulers who would not voice the nation's business.
units.literal: This was a case of words not following what duty required.

units.zh: 何曾謂子遵曰：「國家無貽厥之謀，及身而已，後嗣其殆乎！
units.en: He Ceng said to his son Zun: "The state has no plan to hand down its legacy; it will exhaust itself in this generation — will not posterity be endangered?
units.literal: He Ceng said to his son Zun: "The state has no plan to hand down its legacy; it will exhaust itself in this generation — will not posterity be endangered?

units.zh: 此子孫之憂也。」
units.en: That is posterity's worry."
units.literal: That is posterity's worry."

units.zh: 自永熙後王室漸亂，永嘉中天下大壞，及何綏以非辜被殺，皆如曾言。
units.en: From Yongxi onward the clan unraveled; Yongjia's catastrophe and He Sui's unjust death fulfilled his prophecy.
units.literal: After Yongxi the royal house slid into disorder; in Yongjia the realm shattered; when He Sui was killed without guilt — all happened as Ceng had said.

units.zh: 趙王倫廢惠帝于金墉城，改號金墉城為永安宮。
units.en: Sima Lun cast Emperor Hui into Jinyong and renamed Jinyong Fortress the Yong'an Palace.
units.literal: Prince Zhao Sima Lun deposed Emperor Hui at Jinyong fortress and renamed the fortress Yong'an Palace.

units.zh: 帝尋復位而倫誅。
units.en: Hui returned; Lun went to the block.
units.literal: The emperor soon regained the throne and Lun was executed.

units.zh: 惠帝永興元年，詔廢太子覃還為清河王，立成都王潁為皇太弟，猶加侍中、大都督，領丞相，備九錫，封二十郡，如魏王故事。
units.en: In Emperor Hui's first Yongxing year an edict deposed Crown Prince Tan, restoring him as Prince of Qinghe, and established Prince Ying of Chengdu as imperial heir while he still held palace attendant, grand commander, chancellor, the nine bestowals, and twenty commanderies, on the model of the Wei king.
units.literal: In Emperor Hui's first Yongxing year an edict deposed Crown Prince Tan, restoring him as Prince of Qinghe, and established Prince Ying of Chengdu as heir-apparent to the throne, still adding palace attendant, grand commander, chancellor, the full nine bestowals, enfeoffment over twenty commanderies, on the model of the Wei king.

units.zh: 案周禮傳國以胤不以勳，故雖公旦之聖不易成王之嗣，所以遠絕覬覦，永一宗祧。
units.en: Zhou law crowns the legitimate son, not the ablest man, which is why the Duke of Zhou never supplanted King Cheng — it blocks usurpation.
units.literal: The Zhou ritual transmits the state by heir of the body, not by merit; therefore even the Duke of Zhou's sageness did not replace King Cheng's succession — thereby cutting off ambition far off and unifying the ancestral offering forever.

units.zh: 後代遵履，改之則亂。
units.en: Break that pattern, and turmoil follows.
units.literal: Later ages observed this; altering it brings chaos.

units.zh: 今擬非其實，僭差已甚。
units.en: The court's scheme was a fiction and staggeringly presumptuous.
units.literal: Now the arrangement did not match reality; presumption was already extreme.

units.zh: 且既為國嗣，則不應復開封土，兼領庶職。
units.en: An heir ought not also command twenty commanderies and a stack of ministries.
units.literal: Moreover, once one is heir-apparent of the state, one should not again open feudal lands and concurrently hold miscellaneous offices.

units.zh: 此言之不從，進退乖爽，故帝既播越，穎亦不終，是其咎僭也。
units.en: When speech and policy twist so wildly, the emperor is driven into exile and Ying meets no good end — classic presumption blame.
units.literal: This was words unheeded and advance-and-retreat perverse; therefore the emperor was driven into exile and Ying met no good end — this was the fault of presumption.

units.zh: 後猶不悟，又立懷帝為皇太弟。
units.en: Still unrepentant, they repeated the error with Emperor Huai.
units.literal: Later they still did not understand, and again set up Emperor Huai as heir-apparent in the same manner.

units.zh: 懷終流弑，不永厥祚，又其應也。
units.en: Huai perished as a fugitive pretender — another proof of the omen.
units.literal: Huai in the end was murdered in exile; his line did not last — again the fulfillment.

units.zh: 語曰，「變古易常，不亂則亡」，此之謂乎。
units.en: The saying goes: "Change the archaic and alter the constant — without chaos comes ruin" — was it not this?
units.literal: The saying goes: "Change the archaic and alter the constant — without chaos comes ruin" — was it not this?

units.zh: 元帝永昌二年，大將軍王敦下據姑孰。
units.en: During Yuan-di's Yongchang second year Wang Dun occupied Gushu.
units.literal: In Emperor Yuan's second Yongchang year Grand General Wang Dun descended and seized Gushu.

units.zh: 百姓訛言行蟲病，食人大孔，數日入腹，入腹則死；
units.en: A panic spread of parasites burrowing through flesh and finishing their victim from within.
units.literal: The people spread a rumor of a worm disease that ate large holes in people; in several days it entered the belly; once inside, death followed;

units.zh: 療之有方，當得白犬膽以為藥。
units.en: Charlatans prescribed gall from a white dog as the cure.
units.literal: for treatment there was a recipe: one needed white dog gall as medicine.

units.zh: 自淮泗遂及京都，數日之間，百姓驚擾，人人皆自云已得蟲病。
units.en: The scare raced from the Huai-Si lowlands to Luoyang until every household insisted worms gnawed at them.
units.literal: From Huai-Si it reached the capital; within days the populace was in turmoil; everyone claimed already to have the worm sickness.

units.zh: 又云，始在外時，當燒鐵以灼之。
units.en: The remedy was to brand oneself with red-hot iron before the creatures reached the gut.
units.literal: They also said that while still outside the body one ought to heat iron and cauterize.

units.zh: 於是翕然，被燒灼者十七八矣。
units.en: In the frenzy seven or eight victims in ten scarred themselves.
units.literal: Thereupon they rushed to comply; seventeen or eighteen in ten suffered burns.

units.zh: 而白犬暴貴，至相請奪，其價十倍。
units.en: White hounds soared in value as families outbid one another.
units.literal: White dogs suddenly became costly; people begged and snatched for them until prices multiplied tenfold.

units.zh: 或有自云能行燒鐵灼者，賃灼百姓，日得五六萬，憊而後已。
units.en: Enterprising torturers rented their branding services for tens of thousands of cash a day.
units.literal: Some claimed they could perform the iron burn, hiring themselves out to cauterize the people, earning fifty or sixty thousand a day until exhausted.

units.zh: 四五日漸靜。
units.en: Within a week the hysteria ebbed.
units.literal: After four or five days it gradually quieted.

units.zh: 說曰：「夫裸蟲人類，而人為之主。
units.en: Exegesis states: "Hairless creatures are the human class, yet humans are their master.
units.literal: Exegesis states: "Hairless creatures are the human class, yet humans are their master.

units.zh: 今云蟲食人，言本同臭類而相殘賊也。
units.en: Now it says worms eat humans — it means those of the same odor-class injuring one another.
units.literal: Now it says worms eat humans — it means those of the same odor-class injuring one another.

units.zh: 自下而上，明其逆也。
units.en: From below to above shows inversion.
units.literal: From below to above shows inversion.

units.zh: 必入腹者，言害由中不由外也。
units.en: That it must enter the belly means harm comes from within, not without.
units.literal: That it must enter the belly means harm comes from within, not without.

units.zh: 犬有守衛之性，白者金色，而膽，用武之主也。
units.en: Dogs have guarding nature; white is the color of metal; gall is the lord of martial application.
units.literal: Dogs have guarding nature; white is the color of metal; gall is the lord of martial application.

units.zh: 帝王之運，王霸會於戌。
units.en: The destiny of emperors and kings — hegemonic convergence meets at the branch xu.
units.literal: The destiny of emperors and kings — hegemonic convergence meets at the branch xu.

units.zh: 戌主用兵，金者晉行，火燒鐵以療疾者，言必去其類而來火與金合德，共除蟲害也。」
units.en: Xu governs the use of arms; metal is Jin's phase; fire burning iron to treat disease means casting out the alien kind so fire and metal join virtues and together remove the worm scourge."
units.literal: Xu governs the use of arms; metal is Jin's phase; fire burning iron to treat disease means casting out the alien kind so fire and metal join virtues and together remove the worm scourge."

units.zh: 案中興之際，大將軍本以腹心受伊呂之任，而元帝末年，遂攻京邑，明帝諒闇，又有異謀，是以下逆上，腹心內爛也。
units.en: At the Restoration, the grand general had been entrusted as an intimate minister in the manner of Yi Yin and Lü Wang, yet in Emperor Yuan's final years he attacked the capital, and while Emperor Ming was in mourning he again plotted rebellion. This was a case of inferiors turning against superiors, with the dynasty's own heart rotting from within.
units.literal: Considering the restoration: the grand general had been a confidant trusted like Yi Yin or Lü Wang; yet in Emperor Yuan's last years he attacked the capital; under Emperor Ming's mourning veil there were new plots — subordinates rebelled against superiors and the belly-and-heart rotted within.

units.zh: 及錢鳳、沈充等逆兵四合，而為王師所挫，逾月而不能濟水，北中郎劉遐及淮陵內史蘇峻率淮泗之眾以救朝廷，故其謠言首作於淮泗也。
units.en: When Qian Feng and Shen Chong's rebel hosts closed from four sides yet were broken by the imperial army, for over a month unable to ford the river, Northern Commandant Liu Xia and Huailing Neishi Sujun led Huai-Si troops to relieve the court — hence the rumor began in Huai-Si.
units.literal: When Qian Feng and Shen Chong's rebel hosts closed from four sides yet were broken by the imperial army, for over a month unable to ford the river, Northern Garrison Commander Liu Xia and Huailing prefect Su Jun led Huai-Si troops to rescue the court — therefore the rumor first arose in Huai-Si.

units.zh: 朝廷卒以弱制強，罪人授首，是用白犬膽可救之效也。
units.en: The throne survived by lesser force, heads rolled among rebels — the grotesque "cure" had served as metaphor.
units.literal: The court ultimately used weakness to overcome strength; criminals surrendered their heads — this was the efficacy of "white dog gall could save."

units.zh: 海西公時，庾晞四五年中喜為輓歌，自搖大鈴為唱，使左右齊和。
units.en: In the time of the Duke of Haixi, Yu Xi spent years croaking dirges and swinging a temple bell for accompaniment.
units.literal: Under Duke Haixi, Yu Xi for four or five years loved funeral dirges; he shook a great bell to lead the song and made attendants join in chorus.

units.zh: 又宴會輒令倡妓作新安人歌舞離別之辭，其聲悲切。
units.en: His feasts featured courtesans wailing Xin'an leave-taking airs.
units.literal: At banquets he always made singing-girls perform Xin'an-style parting songs; the voices were mournful and keen.

units.zh: 時人怪之，後亦果敗。
units.en: Onlookers shuddered; soon he fell as predicted.
units.literal: People of the time thought it strange; later he indeed met ruin.

units.zh: 太元中，小兒以兩鐵相打於土中，名曰鬥族。
units.en: In the Taiyuan era children clashed iron stakes in the mud in a game they named dòuzú.
units.literal: In the Taiyuan era children beat two pieces of iron in the soil, calling it "clan battle."

units.zh: 後王國寶、王孝伯一姓之中自相攻擊。
units.en: Later Wang Guobao and Wang Xiaobo, of the same surname, attacked each other.
units.literal: Later Wang Guobao and Wang Xiaobo, of the same surname, attacked each other.

units.zh: 桓玄初改年為大亨，遐邇歡言曰「二月了」，故義謀以仲春發也。
units.en: Huan Xuan first changed the era to Daheng; far and near gleefully said "the second month is over," therefore the loyal plot rose in mid-spring.
units.literal: Huan Xuan first changed the era to Daheng; far and near gleefully said "the second month is over," therefore the loyal plot rose in mid-spring.

units.zh: 玄篡立，又改年為建始，以與趙王倫同，又易為永始，永始復是王莽受封之年也。
units.en: His usurpation recycled Sima Lun's Jianshi, then Wang Mang's Yongshi — compounding ill-omened names.
units.literal: When Xuan usurped, he changed the era to Jianshi — the same as Prince Zhao Lun — then switched to Yongshi; Yongshi was likewise the year Wang Mang received his fief.

units.zh: 始徙司馬道子于安成。
units.en: Sima Daozi was packed off to Ancheng to clear the stage.
units.literal: First Sima Daozi was banished to Ancheng.

units.zh: 安帝遜位，出永安宮，封為平固王，琅邪王德文為石陽公，並使住尋陽城。
units.en: An-di abdicated from Yong'an, won a hollow title at Pinggu, while Dewen, Prince of Langya, became duke of Shiyang — both exiled to Xunyang.
units.literal: Emperor An abdicated, left Yong'an Palace, was enfeoffed Prince of Pinggu; Dewen, Prince of Langya, became Duke of Shiyang; both were ordered to reside in Xunyang city.

units.zh: 識者皆以為言不從之妖僭也。
units.en: Every augur read the clumsy reign titles as arrogance and deceitful speech.
units.literal: Those who understood omens all deemed it demonic presumption — words again not obeyed.

units.zh: 武帝初，何曾薄太官御膳，自取私食，子劭又過之，而王愷又過劭。
units.en: He Zeng snubbed the palace chefs for home cooking; He Shao and Wang Kai escalated the indulgence.
units.literal: Early in Emperor Wu's reign He Zeng scorned the imperial kitchen and took private food; his son Shao exceeded him, and Wang Kai exceeded Shao.

units.zh: 王愷、羊琇之儔，盛致聲色，窮珍極麗。
units.en: Wang Kai and Yang Xiu bankrolled musicians, concubines, and luxuries without limit.
units.literal: Wang Kai, Yang Xiu, and their ilk lavished music and women, exhausting treasures and utmost beauty.

units.zh: 至元康中，誇恣成俗，轉相高尚，石崇之侈，遂兼王、何，而儷人主矣。
units.en: Under Yuankang, ostentation turned into fashion until Shi Chong outspent even Wang Kai and He Zeng, shadowing the throne itself.
units.literal: By the Yuankang years extravagance had become custom; people vied to outdo one another; Shi Chong's luxury surpassed Wang and He combined and rivaled the sovereign.

units.zh: 崇既誅死，天下尋亦淪喪。
units.en: Shi Chong's death presaged the empire's swift collapse.
units.literal: After Chong was executed and killed, the realm soon also fell into ruin.

units.zh: 僭逾之咎也。
units.en: The historians chalked it up to rank-breaking excess.
units.literal: This was the fault of presumption and overstepping.

units.zh: 庶征恆陽，劉向以為《春秋》大旱也。
units.en: The subsection on recurring drought follows Liu Xiang's reading of the Annals.
units.literal: Among the lesser omens, "constant yang" — Liu Xiang held that the Spring and Autumn Annals records this as great drought.

units.zh: 其夏旱，雩，《禮》謂之大雩。
units.en: Summer brought bone-dry fields and the court mounted the grand rain prayer called da yu.
units.literal: That summer was drought; they held a yu sacrifice; the Rites call the great yu "da yu."

units.zh: 不傷二穀謂之不雨。
units.en: Canonists distinguished total failure from a drought that spared both staple crops.
units.literal: If the two grains are not injured, it is called "no rain."

units.zh: 京房《易傳》曰：「欲德不用茲謂張，厥災荒，旱也。
units.en: Jing Fang's Treatise on the Changes says: "Desiring virtue but not using it is called 'arrogance'; its calamity is wasteland — drought.
units.literal: Jing Fang's Treatise on the Changes says: "Desiring virtue but not using it is called 'arrogance'; its calamity is wasteland — drought.

units.zh: 其旱陰雲不雨，變而赤，因四際。
units.en: Its drought: dark clouds but no rain; they turn red and spread along the four borders.
units.literal: Its drought: dark clouds but no rain; they turn red and spread along the four borders.

units.zh: 師出過時茲謂廣，其旱不生。
units.en: An army that marches past its season is called "overreach"; its drought — nothing will grow.
units.literal: An army that marches past its season is called "overreach"; its drought — nothing will grow.

units.zh: 上下皆蔽茲謂隔，其旱天赤三月，時有雹殺飛禽。
units.en: When high and low are both blocked it is called "partition"; its drought — the heavens burn red three months, and at times hail kills flying birds.
units.literal: When high and low are both blocked it is called "partition"; its drought — the heavens burn red three months, and at times hail kills flying birds.

units.zh: 上緣求妃茲謂僭，其旱三月大溫亡雲。
units.en: When the ruler improperly seeks concubines it is called "presumption"; its drought — three months of fierce heat without a cloud.
units.literal: When the ruler improperly seeks concubines it is called "presumption"; its drought — three months of fierce heat without a cloud.

units.zh: 君高臺府茲謂犯陰侵陽，其旱萬物根死，數有火災。
units.en: When the ruler raises high terraces and halls it is called "yin encroaching on yang"; its drought — the roots of the myriad things die and fires break out repeatedly.
units.literal: When the ruler raises high terraces and halls it is called "yin encroaching on yang"; its drought — the roots of the myriad things die and fires break out repeatedly.

units.zh: 庶位逾節茲為僭，其旱澤物枯，為火所傷。」
units.en: When common officers leap their stations it is "presumption"; its drought — marsh things wither and are injured by fire."
units.literal: When common officers leap their stations it is "presumption"; its drought — marsh things wither and are injured by fire."

units.zh: 魏明帝太和二年五月，大旱。
units.en: Wei's Ming-di recorded a crushing drought in Taihe 2's fifth month.
units.literal: In the fifth month of Wei Emperor Ming's second Taihe year there was great drought.

units.zh: 元年以来崇廣宮府之應也。
units.en: Readers linked it to the endless new halls raised since Taihe began.
units.literal: This answered the expansion of palaces and offices since the first year of the era.

units.zh: 又，是春宣帝南擒孟達，置二郡，張郃西破諸葛亮，斃馬謖。
units.en: The same season saw Sima Yi seize Meng Da, Zhang He rout Zhuge Liang, and Ma Su die for his defeat.
units.literal: Moreover, that spring Emperor Xuan captured Meng Da in the south and set up two commanderies; Zhang He broke Zhuge Liang in the west and killed Ma Su.

units.zh: 亢陽自大，又其應也。
units.en: Another gloss: unchecked yang pride in the camp mirrored the weather.
units.literal: Yang arrogantly supreme — again its omen.

units.zh: 太和五年三月，自去冬十月至此月不雨。
units.en: Not a drop had fallen from midwinter through the third lunar month.
units.literal: In the third month, from the tenth month of last winter until this month it had not rained.

units.zh: 辛巳，大雩。
units.en: The court staged the grand supplication on the day xin-si.
units.literal: On the xinsi day they held the great yu.

units.zh: 齊王正始元年二月，自去冬十二月至此月不雨。
units.en: Cao Fang's Zhengshi opening saw another rainless span from deep winter into early spring.
units.literal: In the second month of the Qi King's first Zhengshi year, from the twelfth month of last winter until this month it had not rained.

units.zh: 去歲正月，明帝崩。
units.en: Emperor Ming had fallen the previous new year.
units.literal: The first month of last year Emperor Ming died.

units.zh: 二月，曹爽白嗣主，轉宣帝為太傅，外示尊崇，內實欲令事先由已。
units.en: Cao Shuang "promoted" Sima Yi to figurehead tutor while hoarding real power.
units.literal: In the second month Cao Shuang informed the young lord, transferring Emperor Xuan to grand tutor, outwardly honoring him while in truth wishing every decision to pass through himself.

units.zh: 是時宣帝功蓋魏朝，欲德不用之應也。
units.en: Sima Yi's stature eclipsed the court — classic "latent virtue" portents.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Xuan's achievements overshadowed the Wei court — an omen of desired virtue unused.

units.zh: 高貴鄉公甘露三年正月，自去秋至此月旱。
units.en: From autumn through the new year Cao Mao's reign saw no relief from drought.
units.literal: In the first month of Duke Gaoguixiang's third Ganyu year, from last autumn until this month there was drought.

units.zh: 是時文帝圍諸葛誕，眾出過時之應也。
units.en: The annalist tied it to Sima Zhao's long siege of Zhuge Dan — armies overstaying their term.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Wen besieged Zhuge Dan — an omen of hosts marching past their season.

units.zh: 初，壽春秋夏常雨淹城，而此旱逾年，城陷，乃大雨。
units.en: Shouchun had once drowned in seasonal rains; this time the siege starved it a year until walls fell and storms returned.
units.literal: At first Shouchun in spring and summer often rained and flooded the walls, but this drought lasted over a year; when the city fell, then came great rain.

units.zh: 咸以誕為天亡。
units.en: Observers called Zhuge Dan's fall heaven's verdict.
units.literal: All thought Dan heaven-destroyed.

units.zh: 吳孫亮五鳳二年，大旱，百姓饑。
units.en: Sun Liang's Wufeng 2 brought famine-level drought to Wu.
units.literal: In Wu Sun Liang's second Wufeng year there was great drought; the people starved.

units.zh: 是歲征役煩興，軍士怨叛。
units.en: Endless drafts and labor gangs turned the army mutinous.
units.literal: That year levies and corvée multiplied; soldiers resented and rebelled.

units.zh: 此亢陽自大，勞役失眾之罰也。
units.en: The moralists blamed swaggering policy and exhausted commoners.
units.literal: This was punishment for arrogant yang and labor that lost the multitude.

units.zh: 其役彌歲，故旱亦竟年。
units.en: Because corvée ran twelve months, the drought did too.
units.literal: The service lasted the whole year, so the drought also lasted the year.

units.zh: 孫皓寶鼎元年，春夏旱。
units.en: Sun Hao's Baoding years opened with a spring-and-summer dry spell.
units.literal: Sun Hao — drought in spring and summer.

units.zh: 時孫皓遷都武昌，勞役動眾之應也。
units.en: At the time Sun Hao moved the capital to Wuchang — labor that stirred the masses to match the omen.
units.literal: At the time Sun Hao moved the capital to Wuchang — an omen of labor that stirred the masses.

units.zh: 武帝泰始七年五月閏月旱，大雩。
units.en: Sima Yan's Taishi 7 intercalary fifth month brought another da yu season.
units.literal: Emperor Wu — intercalary fifth month drought; great yu.

units.zh: 泰始八年五月，旱。
units.en: the eighth year of Taishi's fifth month stayed rainless.
units.literal: Fifth month of the eighth year — drought.

units.zh: 是時帝納荀勖邪說，留賈充不復西鎮，而任愷漸疏，上下皆蔽之應也。
units.en: Bad faith at court — Xun Xu's whispering, Jia Chong's stalled western posting, Ren Kai sidelined — mirrored blocked communication.
units.literal: At that time the emperor accepted Xun Xu's vicious counsel, kept Jia Chong at court instead of sending him west again, and Ren Kai grew estranged — an omen of high and low both blocked.

units.zh: 及李憙、魯芝、李胤等並在散職，近厥德不用之謂也。
units.en: Moreover Li Xi, Lu Zhi, Li Yin and others all held idle posts — close to desired virtue unused.
units.literal: Moreover Li Xi, Lu Zhi, Li Yin and others all held idle posts — close to "desired virtue unused."

units.zh: 九年，自正月旱，至於六月，祈宗廟社稷山川。
units.en: In the ninth year drought lasted from the first month through the sixth, and they prayed at the ancestral temple, the altars of soil and grain, and the mountains and rivers.
units.literal: Ninth year: from the first month drought until the sixth; they prayed at ancestral temple, soil and grain altars, mountains and rivers.

units.zh: 癸未，雨。
units.en: Rain finally came on gui-wei.
units.literal: On guiwei it rained.

units.zh: 十年四月，旱。
units.en: Taishi 10's fourth month dried up again.
units.literal: Tenth year, fourth month — drought.

units.zh: 去年秋冬，采擇卿校諸葛沖等女。
units.en: Last autumn and winter they drafted the daughters of Qing-xiao Zhuge Chong and others.
units.literal: Last autumn and winter they drafted the daughters of Qing-xiao Zhuge Chong and others.

units.zh: 是春，五十餘人入殿簡選。
units.en: Fifty-odd girls were marched into the selection hall that spring.
units.literal: That spring more than fifty entered the hall for selection.

units.zh: 又取小將吏女數十人，母子號哭于宮中，聲聞于外，行人悲酸。
units.en: More girls torn from low-ranking families set the inner palace echoing with grief.
units.literal: They also took several tens of junior officers' daughters; mothers and children wailed in the palace, heard outside; passersby were heartsick.

units.zh: 是殆積陰生陽，上緣求妃之應也。
units.en: Moralists read it as yin-turned-yang violence from predatory harem raids.
units.literal: This was perhaps yin amassed engendering yang — an omen of the ruler improperly seeking concubines.

units.zh: 咸寧二年五月旱，大雩。
units.en: Xianning 2's fifth month summoned another grand rain prayer.
units.literal: Fifth month drought; great yu.

units.zh: 至六月，乃澍雨。
units.en: Sudden downpours arrived in the sixth month.
units.literal: By the sixth month, soaking rain finally fell.

units.zh: 太康二年旱，自去冬旱至此春。
units.en: Taikang 2's drought stretched from the prior winter deep into spring.
units.literal: Drought — from last winter's drought until this spring.

units.zh: 太康三年四月旱，乙酉詔司空齊王攸與尚書、廷尉、河南尹錄訊系囚，事從蠲宥。
units.en: Taikang 3's dry fourth month forced an amnesty review led by Sima You.
units.literal: Third year, fourth month drought; on yiyou an edict ordered Sikong Prince Qi You with the Shangshu, tingwei, and Henan Yin to review prisoners and grant mercy as fit.

units.zh: 五年六月，旱。
units.en: Taikang 5's sixth month stayed parched.
units.literal: Sixth month of the fifth year — drought.

units.zh: 此年正月天陰，解而復合。
units.en: Ominous skies flickered between clear and leaden.
units.literal: That year's first month the sky was overcast, cleared, then closed again.

units.zh: 劉毅上疏曰：「必有阿黨之臣奸以事君者，當誅而不赦也。」
units.en: Liu Yi submitted a memorial saying: "There must be partisan ministers who deceive the ruler — they should be executed without pardon."
units.literal: Liu Yi submitted a memorial saying: "There must be partisan ministers who deceive the ruler — they should be executed without pardon."

units.zh: 帝不答。
units.en: The throne stayed silent.
units.literal: The emperor did not answer.

units.zh: 是時荀勖、馮紞僭作威福，亂朝尤甚。
units.en: Xun Xu and Feng Dan terrorized the bureaucracy unchecked.
units.literal: At that time Xun Xu and Feng Dan presumptuously wielded favor and terror, disordering the court worst of all.

units.zh: 六年三月，青、梁、幽、冀郡國旱。
units.en: Taikang 6's third month scorched four northern provinces.
units.literal: Third month of the sixth year — drought in Qing, Liang, You, and Ji commanderies and states.

units.zh: 六月，濟陰、武陵旱，傷麥。
units.en: Late summer drought hit Jiyin and Wuling, ruining the wheat.
units.literal: Sixth month — Jiyin and Wuling drought, injuring wheat.

units.zh: 七年夏，郡國十三大旱。
units.en: Thirteen jurisdictions baked in Taikang 7's summer.
units.literal: Seventh year summer — thirteen commanderies and states great drought.

units.zh: 八年四月，冀州旱。
units.en: Ji Province dried up in the fourth month of year eight.
units.literal: Fourth month of the eighth year — Ji Province drought.

units.zh: 九年夏，郡國三十三旱，扶風、始平、京兆、安定旱，傷麥。
units.en: Taikang 9 saw thirty-three regions wither, including the capital districts.
units.literal: Ninth year summer — thirty-three commanderies and states drought; Fufeng, Shiping, Jingzhao, Dingan drought, injuring wheat.

units.zh: 十年二月，旱。
units.en: Even Taikang 10 opened with drought.
units.literal: Tenth year, second month — drought.

units.zh: 太熙元年二月，旱。
units.en: Taixi 1's second month brought yet another dry spell.
units.literal: Second month — drought.

units.zh: 自太康已後，雖正人滿朝，不被親仗，而賈充、荀勖、楊駿、馮紞等迭居要重，所以無年不旱者，欲德不用，上下皆蔽，庶位逾節之罰也。
units.en: The litany blames perennial drought on the trust placed in Jia Chong, Xun Xu, Yang Jun, and Feng Dan while excluding honest ministers.
units.literal: Since Taikang, although upright men filled the court they were not trusted; Jia Chong, Xun Xu, Yang Jun, Feng Dan and others rotated through critical posts — hence drought year after year: desired virtue unused, high and low blocked, common officers overstepping — their punishment.

units.zh: 惠帝元康七年七月，秦、雍二州大旱，疾疫，關中饑，米斛萬錢。
units.en: Seventh month of Emperor Hui's Yuankang 7 — great drought in Qin and Yong provinces, pestilence, Guanzhong famine, rice ten thousand cash per hu.
units.literal: Seventh month of Emperor Hui — great drought in Qin and Yong provinces, pestilence, Guanzhong famine, rice ten thousand cash per hu.

units.zh: 因此氐羌反叛，雍州刺史解系敗績。
units.en: Di and Qiang uprisings followed, crushing Inspector Jie Xi.
units.literal: Thereupon Di and Qiang rebelled; Yongzhou inspector Jie Xi was defeated.

units.zh: 而饑疫薦臻，戎晉並困，朝廷不能振，詔聽相賣鬻。
units.en: Starvation and plague broke both barbarian and Chinese communities until the throne legalized selling kin to survive.
units.literal: Famine and pestilence piled up; Rong and Jin alike were trapped; the court could not relieve them; an edict allowed mutual sale (of persons).

units.zh: 其九月，郡國五旱。
units.en: Five more jurisdictions reported drought that autumn.
units.literal: That ninth month — five commanderies and states drought.

units.zh: 永甯元年，自夏及秋，青、徐、幽、并四州旱。
units.en: Yongning 1 scorched four provinces from midsummer into fall.
units.literal: First Yongning year: from summer through autumn drought in Qing, Xu, You, and Bing provinces.

units.zh: 十二月，又郡國十二旱。
units.en: Winter brought a dozen more drought reports.
units.literal: Twelfth month — again twelve commanderies and states drought.

units.zh: 是年春，三王討趙王倫，六旬之中數十戰，死者十餘萬人。
units.en: The war on Sima Lun killed over a hundred thousand in two months.
units.literal: That spring the three kings campaigned against Prince Zhao Lun; within sixty days dozens of battles, more than a hundred thousand dead.

units.zh: 懷帝永嘉三年五月，大旱，襄平縣梁水淡池竭，河、洛、江、漢皆可涉。
units.en: Emperor Huai's Yongjia 3, fifth month — great drought; rivers could be forded.
units.literal: Emperor Huai — fifth month great drought; Liang River's brackish pool in Xiangping dried; the Yellow, Luo, Yangzi, and Han could be waded.

units.zh: 是年三月，司馬越歸京都，遣兵入宮，收中書令繆播等九人殺之，皆僭逾之罰也。
units.en: Sima Yue's palace coup and execution of Miu Bo's circle exemplified overreach.
units.literal: That year's third month Sima Yue returned to the capital, sent troops into the palace, seized Zhongshu Ling Miu Bo and nine others and killed them — all punishments for presumption.

units.zh: 又四方諸侯多懷無君之心，劉元海、石勒、王彌、李雄之徒賊害百姓，流血成泥，又其應也。
units.en: Moreover many lords harbored disloyal hearts; Liu Yuanhai, Shi Le, Wang Mi, Li Xiong and their ilk murdered the people until blood puddled as mud — also the drought's echo.
units.literal: Moreover many lords in the four directions harbored disloyal hearts; Liu Yuan, Shi Le, Wang Mi, Li Xiong and their ilk murdered the people until blood mired like mud — again its fulfillment.

units.zh: 五年，自去冬旱至此春。
units.en: Yongjia 5 continued the dry winter into spring.
units.literal: Fifth year: from last winter's drought until this spring.

units.zh: 去歲十一月，司馬越以行台自隨，斥黜宮衛，無君臣之節。
units.en: Sima Yue's mobile headquarters and dismissal of household guards broke every bond of ceremony.
units.literal: Eleventh month of last year Sima Yue brought his field headquarters along, cashiered palace guards — no ruler-subject propriety.

units.zh: 元帝建武元年六月，揚州旱。
units.en: Emperor Yuan's Jianwu 1, sixth month — Yang Province drought.
units.literal: Emperor Yuan — sixth month, Yang Province drought.

units.zh: 去年十二月，淳于伯冤死，其年即旱，而太興元年六月又旱。
units.en: The unjust execution of Chunyu Bo prefaced back-to-back drought years.
units.literal: Last year's twelfth month Chunyu Bo died wrongfully; that year was drought, and Taixing 1 sixth month drought again.

units.zh: 干寶曰「殺淳于伯之後旱三年」是也。
units.en: Gan Bao said "after killing Chunyu Bo drought three years" — that is correct.
units.literal: Gan Bao said "after killing Chunyu Bo drought three years" — that is correct.

units.zh: 刑罰妄加，群陰不附，則陽氣勝之罰也。
units.en: False justice, alienated ministers, and drought march together.
units.literal: When punishments are wantonly applied and the many yin do not cleave, it is yang prevailing — punishment.

units.zh: 元帝太興四年五月，旱。
units.en: Emperor Yuan's Taixing 4, fifth month — drought.
units.literal: Emperor Yuan — fifth month, drought.

units.zh: 是時王敦陵僭已著。
units.en: Wang Dun's bullying had become unmistakable.
units.literal: At that time Wang Dun's arrogation was already plain.

units.zh: 永昌元年夏，大旱。
units.en: Yongchang 1's summer seared the capital region.
units.literal: Summer — great drought.

units.zh: 是年三月，王敦有石頭之變，二宮陵辱，大臣誅死，僭逾無上，故旱尤甚也。
units.en: Wang Dun's Shitou mutiny, double-palace outrage, and ministerial bloodshed deepened the drought.
units.literal: That year's third month Wang Dun staged the Shitou coup; both palaces were humiliated; great ministers were executed; presumption beyond the throne — therefore the drought was especially severe.

units.zh: 其閏十一月，京都大旱，川穀並竭。
units.en: By leap-month winter even the capital's streams had failed.
units.literal: That intercalary eleventh month the capital great drought; rivers and valleys alike ran dry.

units.zh: 明帝太寧三年，自春不雨，至於六月。
units.en: Ming-di's Taining 3 saw not a shower from spring into summer.
units.literal: Emperor Ming — from spring no rain until the sixth month.

units.zh: 成帝咸和元年，夏秋旱。
units.en: Cheng-di's Xianhe opening scorched summer and fall.
units.literal: Emperor Cheng — drought in summer and autumn.

units.zh: 是時庾太后臨朝稱制，言不從而僭逾之罰也。
units.en: Yu Wenjun's regency supplied the political gloss for the weather.
units.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Yu held court and issued edicts — punishment for words unheeded and presumption.

units.zh: 咸和二年夏，旱。
units.en: Xianhe 2's summer stayed rainless.
units.literal: Second year summer — drought.

units.zh: 咸和五年五月，大旱。
units.en: Xianhe 5's fifth month was a major drought.
units.literal: Fifth year fifth month — great drought.

units.zh: 咸和六年四月，大旱。
units.en: Xianhe 6's fourth month repeated the calamity.
units.literal: Sixth year fourth month — great drought.

units.zh: 咸和八年秋七月，旱。
units.en: Late summer of Xianhe 8 brought another dry spell.
units.literal: Eighth year autumn seventh month — drought.

units.zh: 咸和九年，自四月不雨，至於八月。
units.en: Xianhe 9 saw four rainless months midyear.
units.literal: Ninth year: from the fourth month no rain until the eighth.

units.zh: 咸康元年六月，旱。
units.en: Xiankang 1 opened with a June drought.
units.literal: Sixth month — drought.

units.zh: 是時成帝沖弱，未親萬機，內外之政，決之將相。
units.en: The boy emperor left statecraft to generals and ministers.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Cheng was young and weak, had not yet taken the myriad threads; inner and outer policy was decided by generals and ministers.

units.zh: 此僭逾之罰，連歲旱也。
units.en: Yearly drought was the fine for usurped authority.
units.literal: This punishment for presumption — drought year after year.

units.zh: 至四年，王導固讓太傅，復子明辟。
units.en: In the fourth year Wang Dao refused the grand tutorship and returned visible rule to the throne.
units.literal: By the fourth year Wang Dao firmly declined grand tutor and restored the emperor's clear audience.

units.zh: 是後不旱，殆其應也。
units.en: Rains returned once power reverted to the palace.
units.literal: After that it was not drought — likely its response.

units.zh: 時天下普旱，會稽、余姚特甚，米斗直五百，人有相鬻者。
units.en: Nationwide drought peaked in Kuaiji and Yuyao at five hundred cash a dou, until kin sold kin.
units.literal: At the time the whole realm was drought; Kuaiji and Yuyao worst; rice five hundred cash per dou; people sold one another.

units.zh: 咸康二年三月，旱。
units.en: Xiankang 2's third month dried up again.
units.literal: Second year third month — drought.

units.zh: 咸康三年六月，旱。
units.en: Xiankang 3's sixth month stayed harsh.
units.literal: Third year sixth month — drought.

units.zh: 時王導以天下新定，務在遵養，不任刑罰，遂盜賊公行，頻五年亢旱，亦舒綬之應也。
units.en: Wang Dao's soft hand let robbers roam and drought linger five years — the price of lax rule.
units.literal: At that time Wang Dao, because the realm was newly settled, aimed at nurturing and ease, would not employ punishments; thereupon bandits walked openly; five years running severe drought — also an omen of slack government.

units.zh: 康帝建元元年五月，旱。
units.en: Kang-di's the first year of Jianyuan fifth month added another dry entry.
units.literal: Emperor Kang — fifth month, drought.

units.zh: 穆帝永和元年五月，旱。
units.en: Yonghe 1's fifth month brought drought under Emperor Mu.
units.literal: Emperor Mu — fifth month, drought.

units.zh: 是時帝在襁褓，褚太后臨朝，如明穆太后故事。
units.en: The boy on the throne left regency to Empress Dowager Chu, as under Mingmu before.
units.literal: At that time the emperor was still in swaddling clothes; Empress Dowager Chu held court, following the precedent of Empress Dowager Mingmu.

units.zh: 永和五年七月不雨，至于十月。
units.en: From midsummer through autumn Yonghe 5 stayed utterly dry.
units.literal: Fifth year, seventh month — no rain until the tenth month.

units.zh: 永和六年夏，旱。
units.en: Yonghe 6's summer scorched the fields again.
units.literal: Sixth year, summer — drought.

units.zh: 永和八年夏，旱。
units.en: Two years later another summer drought struck.
units.literal: Eighth year, summer — drought.

units.zh: 永和九年春，旱。
units.en: Even spring of Yonghe 9 lacked rain.
units.literal: Ninth year, spring — drought.

units.zh: 升平三年冬，大旱。
units.en: Shengping 3's winter was one of the great dry spells.
units.literal: Shengping third year, winter — great drought.

units.zh: 升平四年冬，大旱。
units.en: Shengping 4's winter repeated the calamity.
units.literal: Fourth year, winter — great drought.

units.zh: 哀帝隆和元年夏，旱。
units.en: Longhe 1's summer parched the realm under Emperor Ai.
units.literal: Emperor Ai — summer, drought.

units.zh: 是時桓溫強恣，權制朝廷，僭逾之罰也。
units.en: Huan Wen's stranglehold on the court explained the omen.
units.literal: At that time Huan Wen acted with force and license, controlling the court at will — punishment for presumption.

units.zh: 海西公太和元年夏，旱。
units.en: Duke Haixi's Taihe 1 summer — drought.
units.literal: Duke Haixi — summer, drought.

units.zh: 四年冬，旱。
units.en: Winter of his fourth year stayed rainless.
units.literal: Fourth year, winter — drought.

units.zh: 涼州春旱至夏。
units.en: The northwest baked from spring into summer.
units.literal: Liangzhou — spring drought through summer.

units.zh: 簡文帝咸安元年十月，大旱，饑。
units.en: Xianan 1's tenth month brought famine-level drought.
units.literal: Emperor Jianwen — tenth month, great drought, famine.

units.zh: 自永和至是，嗣主幼沖，桓溫陵僭，用兵征伐，百姓怨苦。
units.en: Decades of child emperors and Huan Wen's wars had exhausted the country.
units.literal: From Yonghe until then the successors were infants; Huan Wen bullied and usurped authority; armies marched; the people groaned.

units.zh: 孝武帝甯康元年三月，旱。
units.en: Ningkang 1 opened dry under Xiaowu.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaowu, Ningkang first year, third month — drought.

units.zh: 是時桓溫入覲高平陵，闔朝致拜，逾僭之應也。
units.en: Huan Wen's reception at the mausoleum flouted every sumptuary rule.
units.literal: At that time Huan Wen entered court for Gaoping Mausoleum; the whole court bowed to him — an omen of overstepping.

units.zh: 三年冬，旱。
units.en: In the winter of Ningkang 3, drought struck.
units.literal: Third year, winter — drought.

units.zh: 太元四年夏，大旱。
units.en: The summer of Taiyuan 4 brought a severe drought.
units.literal: Taiyuan 4, summer — great drought.

units.zh: 八年六月，旱。
units.en: In the sixth month of Taiyuan 8, there was drought.
units.literal: Eighth year, sixth month — drought.

units.zh: 十年七月，旱，饑。
units.en: By the seventh month of Taiyuan 10, drought had become famine.
units.literal: Tenth year, seventh month — drought and famine.

units.zh: 初，八年破苻堅，九年諸將略地，有事徐豫，楊亮、趙統攻討巴沔。
units.en: At first, in the eighth year Fu Jian was broken; in the ninth generals raided territory — operations in Xu-Yu; Yang Liang and Zhao Tong campaigned against Ba-Mian.
units.literal: At first, in the eighth year Fu Jian was broken; in the ninth generals raided territory — operations in Xu-Yu; Yang Liang and Zhao Tong campaigned in Ba-Mian.

units.zh: 是年正月，謝安又出鎮廣陵，使子琰進次彭城，頻有軍役。
units.en: That year's first month Xie An again went out to garrison Guangling, sent his son Yan forward to Pengcheng — military service piled up.
units.literal: That year's first month Xie An again went out to garrison Guangling, sent his son Yan forward to Pengcheng — military service piled up.

units.zh: 太元十三年六月，旱。
units.en: Taiyuan 13's sixth month dried up again.
units.literal: Thirteenth year, sixth month — drought.

units.zh: 去歲北府遣戍胡陸，荊州經略河南。
units.en: Frontier garrisons on the Huai line matched the timing.
units.literal: Last year the Northern Headquarters sent garrisons to Hulu; Jing province planned operations south of the Yellow River.

units.zh: 是年夏，郭銓置戍野王，又遣軍破黃淮。
units.en: That summer Guo Quan planted a garrison at Yewang and also sent troops to defeat Huang-Huai.
units.literal: That summer Guo Quan planted a garrison at Yewang and also sent troops to defeat Huang-Huai.

units.zh: 太元十五年七月，旱。
units.en: Taiyuan 15's heat refused to break.
units.literal: Fifteenth year, seventh month — drought.

units.zh: 十七年，秋旱至冬。
units.en: Drought ran from autumn clean through winter of Taiyuan 17.
units.literal: Seventeenth year — autumn drought into winter.

units.zh: 是時烈宗仁恕，信任會稽王道子，政事舒緩。
units.en: Xiaowu's softness and Dao-zi's lax rule framed the gloss.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Liezong was lenient and trusting; he relied on Prince Kuaiji, Sima Daozi; government affairs were slack.

units.zh: 又茹千秋為驃騎諮議，竊弄主相威福。
units.en: Ru Qianqiu sold offices between prince and throne.
units.literal: Moreover Ru Qianqiu was counselor to the cavalry general, privately twisting sovereign and ministerial authority.

units.zh: 又比丘尼乳母親党及婢僕之子階緣近習，臨部領眾。
units.en: Harim favorites and household riffraff took battlefield posts.
units.literal: Moreover nuns, wet-nurses' kin, and servants' sons climbed through favorites to command troops.

units.zh: 又所在多上春竟囚，不以其辜，建康獄吏，枉暴既甚。
units.en: Judicial torture in the capital ran unchecked.
units.literal: Moreover everywhere men pressed spring trials to closure without guilt proven; Jiankang jailers were wildly cruel.

units.zh: 此又僭逾不從冤濫之罰。
units.en: The moral matched arrogance plus miscarried justice.
units.literal: This again was punishment for presumption, disobedience, and wrongful flooding of punishments.

units.zh: 安帝隆安二年冬，旱，寒甚。
units.en: the second year of Longan's winter paired drought with killing frost.
units.literal: Emperor An — winter, drought, bitter cold.

units.zh: 隆安四年五月，旱。
units.en: the fourth year of Longan's fifth month sagged under drought.
units.literal: Fourth year, fifth month — drought.

units.zh: 五年，夏秋大旱。
units.en: Year five scorched both summer and fall.
units.literal: Fifth year — summer and autumn great drought.

units.zh: 十二月，不雨。
units.en: Deep winter still brought no clouds.
units.literal: Twelfth month — no rain.

units.zh: 時孫恩作亂，桓玄疑貳，迫殺殷仲堪，而朝廷即授以荊州之任，司馬元顯又諷百僚悉使敬己，內外騷動，兵革煩興。
units.en: At that time Sun En rebelled; Huan Xuan hesitated treacherously, forced Yin Zhongkan to his death, yet the court at once gave him Jingzhou; Sima Yuanxian also prompted the officials to honor him — inside and out were stirred, arms rose repeatedly.
units.literal: At that time Sun En rebelled; Huan Xuan hesitated treacherously, forced Yin Zhongkan to his death, yet the court at once gave him Jingzhou; Sima Yuanxian also hinted that every official should defer to him — inside and outside seethed; arms flared endlessly.

units.zh: 此皆陵僭憂愁之應也。
units.en: Each sign mirrored overreach and dread.
units.literal: These were all omens of bullying presumption and anxious disorder.

units.zh: 元興元年七月，大饑。
units.en: In the seventh month of Yuanxing 1, there was a great famine.
units.literal: Yuanxing 1, seventh month — great famine.

units.zh: 九月、十月不雨，泉水涸。
units.en: Two rainless autumn months emptied the wells.
units.literal: Ninth and tenth months — no rain; springs ran dry.

units.zh: 義熙二年六月，不雨。
units.en: Yixi 2's sixth month offered no relief.
units.literal: Second year, sixth month — no rain.

units.zh: 冬，又旱。
units.en: Winter drought returned the same year.
units.literal: Winter — again drought.

units.zh: 時桓玄奢僭，十二月遂篡位。
units.en: Huan Xuan's luxury coup closed the drought narrative.
units.literal: At that time Huan Xuan was extravagant and presumptuous; in the twelfth month he usurped the throne.

units.zh: 義熙三年八月，不雨。
units.en: Yixi 3's late summer stayed cloudless.
units.literal: Third year, eighth month — no rain.

units.zh: 義熙四年冬，不雨。
units.en: Yixi 4's winter was another dry spell.
units.literal: Winter — no rain.

units.zh: 義熙六年九月，不雨。
units.en: Yixi 6's autumn began without showers.
units.literal: Sixth year, ninth month — no rain.

units.zh: 義熙八年十月，不雨。
units.en: Yixi 8 repeated the pattern in the tenth month.
units.literal: Eighth year, tenth month — no rain.

units.zh: 義熙九年，秋冬不雨。
units.en: Yixi 9 saw both seasons pass rainless.
units.literal: Ninth year — autumn and winter without rain.

units.zh: 義熙十年九月，旱。
units.en: Yixi 10's ninth month was formally logged as drought.
units.literal: Tenth year, ninth month — drought.

units.zh: 十二月又旱，井瀆多竭。
units.en: Year-end drought drained even irrigation channels.
units.literal: Twelfth month again drought; many wells and ditches ran out.

units.zh: 是時軍役煩興。
units.en: Endless campaigns kept the omen alive.
units.literal: At that time military service multiplied.

units.en: The edition inserts a line break before the next rubric.
units.literal: (Sectional marker in the received text.)

units.zh: 詩妖
units.en: Subsection: portents voiced in popular verse.
units.literal: Omens in songs.

units.zh: （分段）
units.en: Another editorial divider follows.
units.literal: (Sectional marker in the received text.)

units.zh: 魏明帝太和中，京師歌《兜鈴曹子》，其唱曰「其柰汝曹何」，此詩妖也。
units.en: During Wei Emperor Ming's Taihe years the capital sang "Douling Caozi," its refrain "What can be done about you people?" — this was an omen in song.
units.literal: During Wei Emperor Ming's Taihe years the capital sang "Douling Caozi," its refrain "What can be done about you people?" — this was an omen in song.

units.zh: 其後曹爽見誅，曹氏遂廢。
units.en: Cao Shuang's purge fulfilled the rhyme.
units.literal: Afterward Cao Shuang was executed and the Cao house fell.

units.zh: 景初初，童謠曰：「阿公阿公駕馬車，不意阿公東渡河，阿公來還當柰何！」
units.en: Early Jingchu, a children's rhyme said: "Grandpa, grandpa, drives a horse cart; never thought grandpa would ford the river east; grandpa comes back — what then!"
units.literal: Early Jingchu, a children's rhyme said: "Grandpa, grandpa, drives a horse cart; never thought grandpa would ford the river east; grandpa comes back — what then!"

units.zh: 及宣帝遼東歸，至白屋，當還鎮長安。
units.en: He should have turned west to Chang'an after the Liaodong campaign.
units.literal: When Emperor Xuan returned from Liaodong to Baiwu, he was to go back and garrison Chang'an.

units.zh: 會帝疾篤，急召之，乃乘追鋒車東渡河，終如童謠之言。
units.en: A dying summons sent him racing east instead, matching the omen.
units.literal: The emperor grew desperately ill and summoned him; he rode the "pursuit-blade" carriage east across the river — exactly as the rhyme said.

units.zh: 齊王嘉平中，有謠曰：「白馬素羈西南馳，其誰乘者硃虎騎。」
units.en: Under the Qi King in Jiaping years a rhyme ran: "White horse, white tether galloping southwest — who rides him? The lad called Red Tiger."
units.literal: Under the Qi King in Jiaping years a rhyme ran: "White horse, white tether galloping southwest — who rides him? The lad called Red Tiger."

units.zh: 硃虎者，楚王小字也。
units.en: Listeners decoded Zhu Hu as Prince Chu Biao.
units.literal: Red Tiger" was the childhood name of the Prince of Chu.

units.zh: 王淩、令狐愚聞此謠，謀立彪。
units.en: Wang Ling and Linghu Yu heard the rhyme and plotted to enthrone Biao.
units.literal: Wang Ling and Linghu Yu heard the rhyme and plotted to enthrone Biao.

units.zh: 事發，淩等伏誅，彪賜死。
units.en: Exposure ended Wang Ling and cost Biao his life.
units.literal: The plot surfaced; Ling and associates were executed; Biao was sentenced to suicide.

units.zh: 吳孫亮初，童謠曰；
units.en: Sun Liang's accession brought a cruel jest about Zhuge Ke.
units.literal: Early in Wu Sun Liang's reign a children's rhyme said:

units.zh: 「籲汝恪，何若若，蘆葦單衣篾鉤絡，于何相求常子閣。」
units.en: "Hey Ke, how grand you are — rush mat coat, bamboo-buckle belt; where shall we seek you? At Changzi Pavilion."
units.literal: "Hey Ke, how grand you are — rush mat coat, bamboo-buckle belt; where shall we seek you? At Changzi Pavilion."

units.zh: 「常子閣」者，反語石子堈也。
units.en: "Changzi Pavilion" is reversed speech for "Stone Child Pit."
units.literal: "Changzi Pavilion" is reversed speech for "Stone Child Pit."

units.zh: 鉤絡，鉤帶也。
units.en: The riddle glossed "bamboo hooks" as belts.
units.literal: Gou-luo means a hooked belt.

units.zh: 及諸葛恪死，果以葦席裹身，篾束其要，投之石子堈。
units.en: When Zhuge Ke died, they indeed wrapped him in a rush mat, bound his waist with bamboo strips, and cast him into the gravel pit.
units.literal: When Zhuge Ke died, they indeed wrapped him in a rush mat, bound his waist with bamboo strips, and cast him into the gravel pit.

units.zh: 後聽恪故吏收斂，求之此堈雲。
units.en: Former aides recovered the body from the stones.
units.literal: Later his old clerks were allowed to bury him and searched that pit.

units.zh: 孫亮初，公安有白鼉鳴。
units.en: White river-dragons keened at Gongan when Sun Liang began to rule.
units.literal: Early Sun Liang, Gongan heard white alligators cry.

units.zh: 童謠曰：「白鼉鳴，龜背平。
units.en: A rhyme said: "White alligator sings, turtle shell flat.
units.literal: A rhyme said: "White alligator sings, turtle shell flat.

units.zh: 南郡城中可長生，守死不去義無成。」
units.en: In Nan commandery town you may live long; cling to death and never flee — no honor comes."
units.literal: In Nan commandery town you may live long; cling to death and never flee — no honor comes."

units.zh: 「南郡城中可長生」者，有急易以逃也。
units.en: "In Nan commandery town you may live long" means that when danger comes it is easy to escape.
units.literal: "In Nan commandery town you may live long" means that when danger comes it is easy to escape.

units.zh: 明年，諸葛恪敗，弟融鎮公安，亦見襲，融刮金印龜服之而死。
units.en: Next year Zhuge Ke fell; his brother Rong held Gongan, was attacked, scraped the gold seal turtle and swallowed it — dying.
units.literal: Next year Zhuge Ke fell; his brother Rong held Gongan, was attacked, scraped the gold seal's turtle and swallowed it — dying.

units.zh: 鼉有鱗介，甲兵之象。
units.en: Scaly creatures signified war gear.
units.literal: Alligators have scales and shell — an image of armor and weapons.

units.zh: 又曰，白祥也。
units.en: They doubled as a pale anomaly.
units.literal: It is also called a white auspice.

units.zh: 孫休永安二年，將守質子群聚嬉戲，有異小兒忽來言曰：「三公鋤，司馬如。」
units.en: Sun Xiu, Yong’an 2 — the hostage sons of the generals and garrison commanders had gathered to play when a strange child suddenly came and said, “The Three Dukes hoe; the Sima are like.”
units.literal: Sun Xiu, Yong’an 2 — the hostage sons of the generals and garrison commanders had gathered to play when a strange child suddenly came and said, “The Three Dukes hoe; the Sima are like.”

units.zh: 又曰：「我非人，熒惑星也。」
units.en: It also said: "I am not human — I am the Planet Mars."
units.literal: It also said: "I am not human — I am the Planet Mars."

units.zh: 言畢上升，仰視若曳一匹練，有頃沒。
units.en: The apparition shot upward like a comet and disappeared.
units.literal: Finishing, it rose into the sky; looking up it seemed to trail a bolt of silk; soon it vanished.

units.zh: 干寶曰：「後四年而蜀亡，六年而魏廢，二十一年而吳平。」
units.en: Gan Bao said: "Four years later Shu perished, six years later Wei was cast off, twenty-one years later Wu was pacified."
units.literal: Gan Bao said: "Four years later Shu perished, six years later Wei was cast off, twenty-one years later Wu was pacified."

units.zh: 於是九服歸晉。
units.en: The empire folded back under the Sima house.
units.literal: Thereupon the Nine Domains returned to Jin.

units.zh: 魏與吳蜀並戰國，「三公鋤，司馬如」之謂也。
units.en: Wei fought Wu and Shu as warring states — that is what "The three dukes hoe, the Sima like" meant.
units.literal: Wei fought Wu and Shu as warring states — that is what "The three dukes hoe, the Sima like" meant.

units.zh: 孫皓遣使者祭石印山下妖祠，使者因以丹書岩曰：「楚九州渚，吳九州都。
units.en: Sun Hao sent envoys to sacrifice at a demon shrine below Stone-Seal Mountain; the envoy painted in cinnabar on the cliff: "Chu fills the isles of nine provinces, Wu towers over nine capitals.
units.literal: Sun Hao sent envoys to sacrifice at a demon shrine below Stone-Seal Mountain; the envoy painted in cinnabar on the cliff: "Chu fills the isles of nine provinces, Wu towers over nine capitals.

units.zh: 揚州士，作天子。
units.en: A man of Yangzhou shall become Son of Heaven.
units.literal: A man of Yangzhou shall become Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 四世治，太平矣。」
units.en: Four reigns of order — great peace."
units.literal: Four reigns of order — great peace."

units.zh: 皓聞之，意益張，曰：「從大皇帝至朕四世，太平之主非朕復誰！」
units.en: Hao heard it and swelled with pride, saying: "From Great Emperor down to me is four generations — who but I brings great peace!"
units.literal: Hao heard it and swelled with pride, saying: "From Great Emperor down to me is four generations — who but I brings great peace!"

units.zh: 恣虐逾甚，尋以降亡，近詩妖也。
units.en: His tyranny hastened Wu's fall — another "song omen."
units.literal: His cruelty doubled; soon he surrendered and perished — close to an omen in song.

units.zh: 孫皓天紀中，童謠曰：「阿童復阿童，銜刀游渡江。
units.en: Under Sun Hao's Tianji years a rhyme said: "Atong again Atong, biting a blade he swims the river.
units.literal: Under Sun Hao's Tianji years a rhyme said: "Atong again Atong, biting a blade he swims the river.

units.zh: 不畏岸上獸，但畏水中龍。」
units.en: Fear not beasts on the bank — only fear the dragon in the water."
units.literal: Fear not beasts on the bank — only fear the dragon in the water."

units.zh: 武帝聞之，加王浚龍驤將軍。
units.en: Sima Yan ennobled Wang Jun as "dragon" general on cue.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu heard it, he promoted Wang Jun to Dragon-Loft general.

units.zh: 及征吳，江西眾軍無過者，而王浚先定秣陵。
units.en: Wang Jun's flotilla outran every rival to seize Moling.
units.literal: When Wu was attacked, no western army surpassed his; Wang Jun first took Moling.

units.zh: 武帝太康三年平吳後，江南童謠曰：「局縮肉，數橫目，中國當敗吳當復。」
units.en: After Emperor Wu pacified Wu in Taikang 3, a children’s rhyme south of the Yangtze said, “Shriveled flesh, several horizontal eyes; the Middle Kingdom shall be defeated, Wu shall be restored.”
units.literal: After Emperor Wu pacified Wu in Taikang 3, a children’s rhyme south of the Yangtze said, “Shriveled flesh, several horizontal eyes; the Middle Kingdom shall be defeated, Wu shall be restored.”

units.zh: 又曰：「宮門柱，且當朽，吳當復，在三十年後。」
units.en: It also said: "Palace gate pillars will rot; Wu returns in thirty years."
units.literal: It also said: "Palace gate pillars will rot; Wu returns in thirty years."

units.zh: 又曰：「雞鳴不拊翼，吳復不用力。」
units.en: It also said: "Crows crow without folding wings — Wu needs hardly lift a finger."
units.literal: It also said: "Crows crow without folding wings — Wu needs hardly lift a finger."

units.zh: 于時吳人皆謂在孫氏子孫，故竊發為亂者相繼。
units.en: Locals read the lines as Sun clan prophecy and rebelled in waves.
units.literal: Then Wu people all thought it meant Sun heirs, so secret risings followed one another.

units.zh: 案「橫目」者四字，自吳亡至元帝興幾四十年，元帝興于江東，皆如童謠之言焉。
units.en: Note: "horizontal eyes" forms the graph for "four"; from Wu's fall to Yuan-di's rise in the east was nearly forty years — all matched the rhymes.
units.literal: Note: "horizontal eyes" forms the graph for "four"; from Wu's fall to Yuan-di's rise in the east was nearly forty years — all matched the rhymes.

units.zh: 元帝懦而少斷，「局縮肉」者，有所斥也。
units.en: Yuan-di was timid and indecisive; "shriveled meat" rebukes that weakness.
units.literal: Yuan-di was timid and indecisive; "shriveled meat" rebukes that weakness.

units.zh: 太康末，京洛為《折楊柳》之歌，其曲始有兵革苦辛之辭，終以擒獲斬截之事。
units.en: A new pop song moved from battlefield sorrow to executions.
units.literal: Late Taikang, capital Luoyang sang "Breaking Willows"; the tune began with the bitterness of war and ended with capture and beheading.

units.zh: 是時三楊貴盛而被族滅，太后廢黜，幽死中宮，「折楊柳」之應也。
units.en: At that time the three Yang clans flourished yet were exterminated; the empress dowager was deposed and died imprisoned in the inner palace — the answer to "Breaking Willows."
units.literal: At that time the three Yang clans flourished yet were exterminated; the empress dowager was deposed and died imprisoned in the inner palace — the answer to "Breaking Willows."

units.zh: 惠帝永熙中，河內溫縣有人如狂，造書曰：「光光文長，大戟為牆。
units.en: Under Emperor Hui's Yongxi years, a man in Wen county, Henan, raved like a madman and wrote: "Bright bright Wen-chang — halberds for walls.
units.literal: Under Emperor Hui's Yongxi years, a man in Wen county, Henan, raved like a madman and wrote: "Bright bright Wen-chang — halberds for walls.

units.zh: 毒藥雖行，戟還自傷。」
units.en: Though poison runs its course, halberds wound themselves."
units.literal: Though poison runs its course, halberds wound themselves."

units.zh: 又曰：「兩火沒地，哀哉秋蘭。
units.en: It also said: "Two fires sink into earth — alas, autumn orchid.
units.literal: It also said: "Two fires sink into earth — alas, autumn orchid.

units.zh: 歸形街郵，終為人歎。」
units.en: Form returns to the roadside post — in the end men sigh over you."
units.literal: Form returns to the roadside post — in the end men sigh over you."

units.zh: 及楊駿居內府，以戟為衛，死時又為戟所害傷。
units.en: Yang Jun's halberd corps foretold his own skewering.
units.literal: When Yang Jun dwelt in the inner palace he used halberds for guards; at death he was again wounded by halberds.

units.zh: 楊後被廢，賈后絕其膳八日而崩，葬街郵亭北，百姓哀之也。
units.en: Consort Yang died of Jia Nanfeng's hunger strike and was dumped by the courier station.
units.literal: Empress Yang was deposed; Empress Jia starved her eight days until she died; she was buried north of Jieyou post; the people pitied her.

units.zh: 雨火，武帝諱，蘭，楊後字也。
units.en: Commentators read the paired "fire" graphs as alluding to Emperor Wu's taboo name and "orchid" as Empress Yang Zhi's style name.
units.literal: "Two fires" is Emperor Wu's taboo graph; "orchid" was Empress Yang's style name.

units.zh: 其時又有童謠曰：「二月末，三月初，荊筆楊板行詔書，宮中大馬幾作驢。」
units.en: Then another rhyme ran: "Late second month, early third — Jing brush and Yang tablet carry edicts; the palace's great horse nearly becomes a donkey."
units.literal: Then another rhyme ran: "Late second month, early third — Jing brush and Yang tablet carry edicts; the palace's great horse nearly becomes a donkey."

units.zh: 此時楊駿專權，楚王用事，故言「荊筆楊板」。
units.en: At that time Yang Jun monopolized authority and the Prince of Chu held sway — hence "Jing brush and Yang tablet."
units.literal: At that time Yang Jun monopolized authority and the Prince of Chu held sway — hence "Jing brush and Yang tablet."

units.zh: 二人不誅，則君臣禮悖，故云「幾作驢」也。
units.en: If the two were not executed, ruler-minister ritual would invert — hence "nearly a donkey."
units.literal: If the two were not executed, ruler-minister ritual would invert — hence "nearly a donkey."

units.zh: 元康中，京洛童謠曰：「南風起，吹白沙，遙望魯國何嵯峨，千歲髑髏生齒牙。」
units.en: In Yuankang the capital children sang: "South wind rises, blows white sand; far off how steep the state of Lu — thousand-year skulls sprout teeth."
units.literal: In Yuankang the capital children sang: "South wind rises, blows white sand; far off how steep the state of Lu — thousand-year skulls sprout teeth."

units.zh: 又曰：「城東馬子莫嚨哅，此至來年纏女閤。」
units.en: It also said: "East-city colt, don't whinny — by next year you'll tangle in women's boudoirs."
units.literal: It also said: "East-city colt, don't whinny — by next year you'll tangle in women's boudoirs."

units.zh: 南風，賈后字也。
units.en: Nanfeng was Empress Jia's style name.
units.literal: South wind" is Empress Jia's style name.

units.zh: 白，晉行也。
units.en: White stood for metal — Jin's element.
units.literal: "White" is Jin's phase color.

units.zh: 沙門，太子小名也。
units.en: "Monkling" was the crown prince's childhood name.
units.literal: "Shamen" is the heir apparent's childhood name.

units.zh: 魯，賈謐國也。
units.en: Lu mapped onto Jia Mi's noble seat.
units.literal: "Lu" is Jia Mi's princedom.

units.zh: 言賈后將與謐為亂，以危太子，而趙王因釁咀嚼豪賢，以成篡奪，不得其死之應也。
units.en: The gloss tied the verses to Jia's coup plot and Sima Lun's coming slaughter.
units.literal: It means Empress Jia would riot with Mi to endanger the heir, while Prince Zhao would chew up great men and seize the throne — an omen of dying badly.

units.zh: 元康中，天下商農通著大鄣日。
units.en: Yuankang fashion made everyone don huge visors.
units.literal: In Yuankang merchants and farmers all wore wide sun-hats.

units.zh: 時童謠曰：「屠蘇鄣日覆兩耳，當見瞎兒作天子。」
units.en: A rhyme said: "Tusu hat brim covers both ears — soon a blind boy will be Son of Heaven."
units.literal: A rhyme said: "Tusu hat brim covers both ears — soon a blind boy will be Son of Heaven."

units.zh: 及趙王倫篡位，其目實眇焉。
units.en: Sima Lun's bad eye matched the "blind boy" line.
units.literal: When Prince Zhao Lun usurped, his eye was indeed blind.

units.zh: 趙王倫既篡，洛中童謠曰：「獸從北來鼻頭汗，龍從南來登城看，水從西來河灌灌。」
units.en: After Prince Zhao seized power, Luoyang sang: "Beasts come from the north with sweaty snouts; dragons from the south climb walls to look; water from the west makes rivers boil."
units.literal: After Prince Zhao seized power, Luoyang sang: "Beasts come from the north with sweaty snouts; dragons from the south climb walls to look; water from the west makes rivers boil."

units.zh: 數月而齊王、成都、河間義兵同會誅倫。
units.en: Within months the Prince of Qi, Chengdu, and Hejian righteous hosts jointly executed Lun.
units.literal: Within months Qi, Chengdu, and Hejian righteous hosts jointly executed Lun.

units.zh: 案成都西籓而在鄴，故曰「獸從北來。」
units.en: Chengdu was a western fief but sat at Ye — hence "beasts from the north."
units.literal: Chengdu was a western fief but sat at Ye — hence "beasts from the north."

units.zh: 齊東籓而在許，故曰「龍從南來。」
units.en: Qi was an eastern fief but camped at Xu — hence "dragons from the south."
units.literal: Qi was an eastern fief but camped at Xu — hence "dragons from the south."

units.zh: 河間水源而在關中，故曰「水從西來」。
units.en: Hejian drew water from Guanzhong — hence "water from the west."
units.literal: Hejian drew water from Guanzhong — hence "water from the west."

units.zh: 齊留輔政，居於宮西，又有無君之心，故言「登城看」也。
units.en: Qi stayed to assist government, dwelling west of the palace, yet nursed disloyalty — hence "climb walls to look."
units.literal: Qi stayed to assist government, dwelling west of the palace, yet nursed disloyalty — hence "climb walls to look."

units.zh: 太安中，童謠曰：「五馬游渡江，一馬化為龍。」
units.en: In Tai'an years a rhyme said: "Five horses frolic across the river; one horse turns into a dragon."
units.literal: In Tai'an years a rhyme said: "Five horses frolic across the river; one horse turns into a dragon."

units.zh: 後中原大亂，宗籓多絕，唯琅邪、汝南、西陽、南頓、彭城同至江東，而元帝嗣統矣。
units.en: Only five princely lines escaped to Jiangdong where Sima Rui took the mandate.
units.literal: Later the central plain collapsed; most imperial kin perished; only Langya, Runan, Xiyang, Nandun, and Pengcheng reached the east of the river, and Yuan-di succeeded.

units.zh: 司馬越還洛，有童謠曰：「洛中大鼠長尺二，若不早去大狗至。」
units.en: When Sima Yue returned to Luoyang a rhyme said: "Luoyang's giant rat measures a foot two — if you don't leave soon, a great dog arrives."
units.literal: When Sima Yue returned to Luoyang a rhyme said: "Luoyang's giant rat measures a foot two — if you don't leave soon, a great dog arrives."

units.zh: 及苟晞將破汲桑，又謠曰：「元超兄弟大落度，上桑打椹為苟作。」
units.en: When Gou Xi was about to crush Ji Sang another ran: "Yuan-chao brothers lose their grip; climb mulberries to beat berries for Gou."
units.literal: When Gou Xi was about to crush Ji Sang another ran: "Yuan-chao brothers lose their grip; climb mulberries to beat berries for Gou."

units.zh: 由是越惡晞，奪其兗州，隙難遂構焉。
units.en: The verses stoked Yue's vendetta against Gou Xi.
units.literal: Thereupon Yue hated Xi, stripped his Yan province, and their feud was set.

units.zh: 湣帝初，有童謠曰：「天子何在豆田中。」
units.en: Early in Emperor Min's reign a rhyme asked: "Where is the Son of Heaven? In the bean fields."
units.literal: Early in Emperor Min's reign a rhyme asked: "Where is the Son of Heaven? In the bean fields."

units.zh: 至建興四年，帝降劉曜，在城東豆田壁中。
units.en: By Jianxing 4 he surrendered to Liu Yao in a bean-patch redoubt east of the city.
units.literal: By Jianxing 4 he surrendered to Liu Yao in a bean-patch redoubt east of the city.

units.zh: 建興中，江南謠歌曰：訇如白坑破，合集持作甒。
units.en: Wu dialect song opened with the white-pit couplet.
units.literal: Mid-Jianxing a Jiangnan ballad ran: "Boom — white pit breaks; gather shards to make a jar.

units.zh: 揚州破換敗，吳興覆瓿甊。」
units.en: Yangzhou smashes and falls; Wuxing overturns pots and urns."
units.literal: Yangzhou smashes and falls; Wuxing overturns pots and urns."

units.zh: 案白者，晉行。
units.en: Commentary: white again signaled Jin metal.
units.literal: Note: white is Jin's phase.

units.zh: 坑器有口屬甕，瓦甕質剛，亦金之類也。
units.en: Pottery counted as hard "metal" in the correlative scheme.
units.literal: Pit vessels have mouths like urns; earthen urns are hard — also a kind of metal.

units.zh: 「訇如白坑破」者，言二都傾覆，王室大壞也。
units.en: "Boom — white pit breaks" means both capitals fell and the royal house shattered.
units.literal: "Boom — white pit breaks" means both capitals fell and the royal house shattered.

units.zh: 「合集持作甒」者，元帝鳩集遺餘，以主社稷，未能克復中原，但偏王江南，故其喻也。
units.en: "Gather shards to make a jar" means Yuan-di rounded up survivors to sustain the altars, could not reconquer the north, only ruled south of the river — hence the metaphor.
units.literal: "Gather shards to make a jar" means Yuan-di rounded up survivors to sustain the altars, could not reconquer the north, only ruled south of the river — hence the metaphor.

units.zh: 及石頭之事，六軍大潰，兵人抄掠京邑，爰及二宮。
units.en: Wang Dun's Shitou disaster let troops sack both palace compounds.
units.literal: At the Shitou affair the six armies routed; soldiers plundered the capital, reaching both palaces.

units.zh: 其後三年，錢鳳復攻京邑，阻水而守，相持月餘日，焚燒城邑，井堙木刊矣。
units.en: Qian Feng's second siege charred Jiankang and ruined its wells and groves.
units.literal: Three years later Qian Feng again attacked the capital, blocked the river and held, faced off over a month, burned towns, filled wells and felled trees.

units.zh: 鳳等敗退，沈充將其党還吳興，官軍踵之，蹈藉郡縣，充父子授首，黨與誅者以百數。
units.en: Shen Chong's retreat ended in beheadings and mass executions.
units.literal: When Feng retreated, Shen Chong led his party back to Wuxing; imperial troops followed, trampling commanderies; Chong and son lost their heads; over a hundred accomplices were executed.

units.zh: 所謂「揚州破換敗，吳興覆瓿甊」，瓿甊瓦器，又小於甒也。
