units.zh: 然猶不能優容亮直而多溺偏私矣。
units.en: Favoritism persisted despite the scare.
units.literal: Yet he still could not indulge straight speech and drowned in partiality.

units.zh: 京房《易傳》曰「辟退有德，厥妖水鳥集于國中」。
units.en: Jing Fang says: "When you cast aside virtue waterfowl gather in the capital."
units.literal: Jing Fang says: "When you cast aside virtue waterfowl gather in the capital."

units.zh: 黃初元年，未央宮中又有燕生鷹，口爪俱赤，此與商紂、宋隱同象。
units.en: A swallow hatched a hawk in the Wei harem — ancient tyrants' omen.
units.literal: Huangchu 1 — in Weiyang Palace a swallow bore an eagle; beak and claws all red — same image as Shang Zhou and Song Yin.

units.zh: 景初元年，又有燕生巨鷇於衛國李蓋家，形若鷹，吻似燕，此羽蟲之孽，又赤眚也。
units.en: A second freak hatchling augured Cao Wei's end.
units.literal: Jingchu 1 — another swallow laid a giant chick at Li Gai's home in Wey; shaped like an eagle, beak like a swallow — feathered calamity, also red ill-omen.

units.zh: 高堂隆曰：「此魏室之大異，宜防鷹揚之臣于蕭牆之內。」
units.en: Gaotang Long said: "This is Wei's great prodigy — guard against hawk-like ministers inside the screen wall."
units.literal: Gaotang Long said: "This is Wei's great prodigy — guard against hawk-like ministers inside the screen wall."

units.zh: 其後宣帝起誅曹爽，遂有魏室。
units.en: Sima Yi purged Shuang and seized power.
units.literal: Thereafter Emperor Xuan rose and executed Cao Shuang, taking Wei.

units.zh: 漢獻帝建安二十三年，禿鶖鳥集鄴宮文昌殿后池。
units.en: In Jian’an 23 under Han Emperor Xian, pelicans gathered behind Wenchang Hall at Ye.
units.literal: Han Emperor Xian, Jian’an 23 — pelicans gathered at the rear pond of Wenchang Hall in the Ye palace.

units.zh: 明年，魏武王薨。
units.en: Cao Cao perished the next year.
units.literal: Next year King Wu of Wei died.

units.zh: 魏文帝黃初三年，又集雒陽芳林園池。
units.en: In Huangchu 3 under Wei Emperor Wen, the pelicans returned to Fanglin Garden in Luoyang.
units.literal: Wei Emperor Wen, Huangchu 3 — they again gathered at the pond in Luoyang’s Fanglin Garden.

units.zh: 七年，又集。
units.en: A third massing occurred in year seven.
units.literal: Seventh year — gathered again.

units.zh: 其夏，文帝崩。
units.en: Cao Pi died that summer.
units.literal: That summer Emperor Wen died.

units.zh: 景初末，又集芳林園池。
units.en: Late Ming-di saw another flock.
units.literal: Late Jingchu — again gathered at Fanglin pool.

units.zh: 已前再至，輒有大喪，帝惡之。
units.en: Cao Rui dreaded the double visitation.
units.literal: Previously twice arriving meant great mourning; the emperor hated it.

units.zh: 其年，明帝崩。
units.en: He died the same year.
units.literal: That year Emperor Ming died.

units.zh: 蜀劉禪建興九年十月，江陽至江州有鳥從江南飛渡江北，不能達，墮水死者以千數。
units.en: In the tenth month of Jianxing 9 under Liu Shan of Shu, thousands of birds drowned trying to cross the Yangtze northward between Jiangyang and Jiangzhou.
units.literal: Shu Liu Shan, Jianxing 9, tenth month — from Jiangyang to Jiangzhou, birds flew from south of the river toward the north bank, could not reach it, and fell into the water dead by the thousands.

units.zh: 是時諸葛亮連年動眾，志吞中夏，而終死渭南，所圖不遂。
units.en: Zhuge's northern drives stalled at Wei River.
units.literal: Then Zhuge Liang campaigned yearly, aimed to swallow the central plain, yet died south of Wei River — plans unfulfilled.

units.zh: 又諸將分爭，頗喪徒旅，鳥北飛不能達墮水死者，皆有其象也。
units.en: The drownings mirrored Shu's failed offensives.
units.literal: Also generals quarreled, losing troops; birds failing north and drowning matched each item.

units.zh: 亮竟不能過渭，又其應乎！
units.en: He never crossed the river — the omen held.
units.literal: Liang never crossed Wei — was this not the answer?

units.zh: 此與漢時楚國烏鬥墮泗水粗類矣。
units.en: Historians recalled Han crow omens.
units.literal: This roughly matches Han-era Chu crows fighting and falling into Si River.

units.zh: 景初元年，陵霄闕始構，有鵲巢其上。
units.en: Magpies built on the new tower.
units.literal: Jingchu 1 — Lingxiao Gate began construction; magpies nested atop.

units.zh: 鵲體白黑雜色，此羽蟲之孽，又白黑祥也。
units.en: Pied magpies doubled as yin-yang portent.
units.literal: Magpie body mottled white-black — feathered calamity, also white-black omen.

units.zh: 帝以問高堂隆，對曰：「《詩》云『惟鵲有巢，惟鳩居之』，今興起宮室而鵲來巢，此宮室未成身不得居之象也。
units.en: The emperor asked Gao Tang Long, who replied: "The Book of Songs says, 'The magpie has a nest; the turtledove dwells in it.' Now palaces are being raised and magpies come to nest; this is the image that the palace halls are unfinished and your person cannot dwell in them.
units.literal: The emperor asked Gao Tang Long, who replied: "The Book of Songs says, 'The magpie has a nest; the turtledove dwells in it.' Now palaces are being raised and magpies come to nest; this is the image that the palace halls are unfinished and your person cannot dwell in them.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，宮室未成，將有他姓制御之，不可不深慮。」
units.en: Heaven's warning is as if to say: the palace halls are unfinished, and another surname will control them; this must be pondered deeply."
units.literal: Heaven's warning is as if to say: the palace halls are unfinished, and another surname will control them; this must be pondered deeply."

units.zh: 於是帝改顏動色。
units.en: Cao Rui blanched at the gloss.
units.literal: Thereupon the emperor changed color.

units.zh: 吳孫權赤烏十二年四月，有兩烏銜鵲墮東館，權使領丞相硃據燎鵲以祭。
units.en: In the fourth month of Chiwu 12 under Sun Quan, crows dropped a magpie at the Eastern Lodge, and Zhu Ju was ordered to burn it in sacrifice.
units.literal: Wu Sun Quan, Chiwu 12, fourth month — two crows carrying a magpie dropped it at the Eastern Lodge; Quan had acting chancellor Zhu Ju burn the magpie as a sacrifice.

units.zh: 案劉歆說，此羽蟲之孽，又黑祥也。
units.en: Black-bird symbolism applied.
units.literal: Liu Xin's doctrine: feathered calamity, also black omen.

units.zh: 視不明、聽不聰之罰也。
units.en: The court had mis-seen and mis-heard.
units.literal: Punishment for unclear sight and deaf hearing.

units.zh: 是時權意溢德衰，信讒好殺，二子將危，將相俱殆，睹妖不悟，加之以燎，昧道之甚者也。
units.en: Sun Quan burned the omen and deepened his moral blindness.
units.literal: Then Quan's intent overflowed while virtue waned; he trusted slander and loved killing; two heirs were endangered, generals imperiled; seeing portent yet unawares he added fire sacrifice — utmost blindness.

units.zh: 明年，太子和廢，魯王霸賜死，硃據左遷，陸議憂卒，是其應也。
units.en: The succession war consumed his heirs and ministers.
units.literal: Next year Heir Apparent He was deposed, Prince Ba forced to die, Zhu Ju demoted, Lu Xun died of grief — the answer.

units.zh: 東館，典教之府；
units.en: Dongguan housed education.
units.literal: East Lodge was the canon instruction office;

units.zh: 鵲墮東館，又天意乎？
units.en: The drop-site magnified the warning.
units.literal: Magpie falling on East Lodge — was it not Heaven's intent?

units.zh: 吳孫權太元二年正月，封前太子和為南陽王，遣之長沙，有鵲巢其帆檣。
units.en: In the first month of Taiyuan 2 under Sun Quan, when the former heir He was sent to Changsha as Prince of Nanyang, magpies nested on his ship’s mast.
units.literal: Wu Sun Quan, Taiyuan 2, first month — he enfeoffed the former heir He as Prince of Nanyang and sent him to Changsha; magpies nested on his mast.

units.zh: 和故宮僚聞之，皆憂慘，以為檣末傾危，非久安之象。
units.en: His retinue saw disaster in the rigging.
units.literal: Sun He's former staff heard it and grieved, reckoning mast-ends tottering — no sign of long peace.

units.zh: 是後果不得其死。
units.en: Sun He died violently.
units.literal: Afterward he indeed met unnatural death.

units.zh: 孫亮建興二年十一月，有大鳥五見於春申，吳人以為鳳皇。
units.en: In the eleventh month of Jianxing 2 under Sun Liang, five great birds appeared at Chunshen and were hailed in Wu as phoenixes.
units.literal: Sun Liang, Jianxing 2, eleventh month — five great birds appeared at Chunshen, and the people of Wu took them for phoenixes.

units.zh: 明年，改元為五鳳。
units.en: The reign title echoed the five birds.
units.literal: Next year the era was renamed Wufeng.

units.zh: 漢桓帝時有五色大鳥，司馬彪云：「政道衰缺，無以致鳳，乃羽蟲孽耳。」
units.en: Han Emperor Huan had a five-colored great bird; Sima Biao said: "With decayed government you cannot summon a phoenix — only feathered calamity."
units.literal: Han Emperor Huan had a five-colored great bird; Sima Biao said: "With decayed government you cannot summon a phoenix — only feathered calamity."

units.zh: 孫亮未有德政，孫峻驕暴方甚，此與桓帝同事也。
units.en: Sun Liang lacked virtuous government and Sun Jun was arrogant and violent, matching Emperor Huan's case.
units.literal: Sun Liang had no virtuous government while Sun Jun was wildly cruel — same affair as Huan.

units.zh: 案《瑞應圖》，大鳥似鳳而為孽者非一，宜皆是也。
units.en: According to the Ruiying tu, more than one great bird resembled a phoenix but was actually an omen of disorder; these should all have been such birds.
units.literal: The Omen Compendium says many great birds resemble phoenix yet are calamity — likely all such cases.

units.zh: 孫皓建衡三年，西苑言鳳皇集，以之改元，義同於亮。
units.en: In Jianheng 3 under Sun Hao, a supposed phoenix gathering in the Western Park prompted an era-name change, much like Sun Liang’s omen.
units.literal: Sun Hao, Jianheng 3 — Western Park reported that phoenixes had gathered, and he changed the era name because of it; the meaning was the same as in Liang’s case.

units.zh: 武帝泰始四年八月，有翟雉飛上閶闔門。
units.en: In the eighth month of the fourth year of Taishi under Emperor Wu, a long-tailed pheasant perched on Changhe Gate.
units.literal: Emperor Wu, Taishi 4, eighth month — a long-tailed pheasant flew up onto Changhe Gate.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，閶闔門非雉所止，猶殷宗雉登鼎耳之戒也。
units.en: The gate omen recalled Shang dynasty precedent.
units.literal: Heaven warns: Changhe Gate is no place for pheasants — like Shang's pheasant on the cauldron ear.

units.zh: 惠帝永康元年，趙王倫既篡，京師得異鳥，莫能名。
units.en: In Yongkang 1 under Emperor Hui, after Sima Lun’s usurpation, the capital captured an unnamed strange bird.
units.literal: Emperor Hui, Yongkang 1 — after Prince Lun of Zhao had usurped, a strange bird was obtained in the capital, and no one could name it.

units.zh: 倫使人持出，周旋城邑市以問人。
units.en: Paraded the bird for identification.
units.literal: Lun had it carried through city markets asking everyone.

units.zh: 積日，宮西有小兒見之，遂自言曰：「服留鳥翳。」
units.en: After days a western-slum boy saw it and said: "It is the 'stay-cloak' bird."
units.literal: After days a western-slum boy saw it and said: "It is the 'stay-cloak' bird."

units.zh: 持者即還白倫，倫使更求，又見之，乃將入宮，密籠鳥，並閉小兒戶中，明日視之，悉不見。
units.en: Lun imprisoned bird and prophet — both disappeared.
units.literal: The bearer reported to Lun; Lun sent to find him again, caged the bird with the boy locked in; next day both vanished.

units.zh: 此羽蟲之孽。
units.en: Another winged portent.
units.literal: This was feathered calamity.

units.zh: 時趙王倫有目瘤之疾，言服留者，謂倫留將服其罪也。
units.en: The pun foretold Lun's execution.
units.literal: Then Prince Zhao Lun had an eye tumor; "stay-cloak" meant Lun would soon suffer punishment.

units.zh: 尋而倫誅。
units.en: Sima Lun fell quickly.
units.literal: Soon Lun was executed.

units.zh: 趙王倫篡位，有鶉入太極殿，雉集東堂。
units.en: Game birds invaded the throne hall.
units.literal: When Prince Zhao Lun usurped, quail entered Taiji Hall, pheasants gathered east hall.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，太極東堂皆朝享聽政之所，而鶉雉同日集之者，趙王倫不當居此位也。
units.en: Twin fowl barred his legitimacy.
units.literal: Heaven warns: Taiji and east hall are where court meets — quail and pheasant the same day means Lun must not occupy that seat.

units.zh: 《詩》云：「鵲之強強，鶉之奔奔，人之無良，我以為君。」
units.en: The Book of Songs says: "Magpie strong-strong, quail darting — the man lacks goodness — I make him lord."
units.literal: The Book of Songs says: "Magpie strong-strong, quail darting — the man lacks goodness — I make him lord."

units.zh: 其此之謂乎！
units.en: Editors applied the ode to Lun.
units.literal: Did it not mean this?

units.zh: 尋而倫誅。
units.en: He died as foretold.
units.literal: Soon Lun was executed.

units.zh: 孝懷帝永嘉元年二月，洛陽東北步廣裏地陷，有蒼白二色鵝出，蒼者飛翔沖天，白者止焉。
units.en: In the second month of Yongjia 1 under Emperor Huai, a Luoyang sinkhole released two geese: the blue-green bird flew skyward and the white one remained.
units.literal: Emperor Huai, Yongjia 1, second month — at Buguang ward northeast of Luoyang, the ground caved in and two geese, blue-green and white, came out; the blue-green one flew soaring into the sky, while the white one stayed there.

units.zh: 此羽蟲之孽，又黑白祥也。
units.en: Dual-colored fowl marked ethnic war.
units.literal: This was feathered calamity, also black-white omen.

units.zh: 陳留董養曰：「步廣，周之狄泉，盟會地也。
units.en: Dong Yang of Chenliu said: "Buguang is Zhou's Di Spring, covenant ground.
units.literal: Dong Yang of Chenliu said: "Buguang is Zhou's Di Spring, covenant ground.

units.zh: 白者，金色，國之行也。
units.en: White is metal color — the state's phase.
units.literal: White is metal color — the state's phase.

units.zh: 蒼為胡象，其可盡言乎？」
units.en: Blue is Hu image — can one say all?"
units.literal: Blue is Hu image — can one say all?"

units.zh: 是後，劉元海、石勒相繼亂華。
units.en: The barbarian onslaught followed.
units.literal: Thereafter Liu Yuan and Shi Le successively ravaged the Chinese heartland.

units.zh: 明帝八月庚戌，有大鳥二，蒼黑色，翼廣一丈四尺，其一集司徒府，射而殺之，其一集市北家人舍，亦獲焉。
units.en: In Emperor Ming's eighth month, on gengxu, two great bluish-black birds with wings one zhang four chi wide appeared; one perched at the Minister of Education's residence and was shot dead, the other at a north-city household and was also taken.
units.literal: Emperor Ming eighth month gengxu — two great bluish-black birds, wings one zhang four chi wide; one perched at Minister of Education residence, shot dead; one at north-city home, also taken.

units.zh: 此羽蟲之孽，又黑祥也。
units.en: Dark wings signaled mourning.
units.literal: Feathered calamity, also black omen.

units.zh: 及閏月戊子而帝崩，後遂有蘇峻、祖約之亂。
units.en: Su Jun's mutiny followed the birds.
units.literal: By intercalary month wuzi the emperor died; afterward Su Jun and Zu Yue rebelled.

units.zh: 成帝咸和二年正月，有五鷗鳥集殿庭，此又白祥也。
units.en: In the first month of Xianhe 2 under Emperor Cheng, five gulls alighted in the court, another white omen.
units.literal: Emperor Cheng, Xianhe 2, first month — five gulls gathered in the palace court; this too was a white omen.

units.zh: 是時庾亮苟違眾謀，將召蘇峻，有言不從之咎，故白祥先見也。
units.en: Yu Liang's stubbornness prefaced white gulls.
units.literal: Then Yu Liang rashly defied counsel and would summon Su Jun — fault of words unheeded — hence white omen first.

units.zh: 三年二月，峻果作亂，宮掖焚毀，化為汙萊，此其應也。
units.en: Su Jun torched the inner palace.
units.literal: Third year second month Jun indeed rebelled; palace burned to wasteland — the answer.

units.zh: 咸康八年七月，有白鷺集殿屋。
units.en: In the eighth year of Xiankang, Egrets settled on the tiles.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Xiankang, seventh month — white herons perched on palace roof.

units.zh: 是時康帝初即位，不永之祥也。
units.en: They augured Kang's brief rule.
units.literal: Then Emperor Kang had just succeeded — omen of short reign.

units.zh: 後涉再期而帝崩。
units.en: He died within two years.
units.literal: Later within two cycles the emperor died.

units.zh: 案劉向曰：「野鳥入處，宮室將空。」
units.en: Liu Xiang says: "Wild birds enter dwellings — palace will empty."
units.literal: Liu Xiang says: "Wild birds enter dwellings — palace will empty."

units.zh: 此其應也。
units.en: Kang's death matched.
units.literal: This was its answer.

units.zh: 海西初以興寧三年二月即位，有野雉集於相風。
units.en: When the Duke of Haixi first took the throne in the second month of Xingning 3, a wild pheasant perched on the wind-vane.
units.literal: Haixi first ascended the throne in Xingning 3, second month; a wild pheasant gathered at the wind-vane.

units.zh: 此羽蟲之孽也。
units.en: Another fowl sign.
units.literal: This was feathered calamity.

units.zh: 尋為桓溫所廢也。
units.en: Wen cast him down.
units.literal: Soon Huan Wen deposed him.

units.zh: 孝武帝太元十六年六月，鵲巢太極東頭鴟尾，又巢國子學堂西頭。
units.en: In the sixth month of Taiyuan 16 under Emperor Xiaowu, magpies nested both on Taiji Hall’s eastern roof ornament and on the west end of the National Academy hall.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaowu, Taiyuan 16, sixth month — magpies nested on the eastern owl-tail roof ornament of Taiji Hall and also on the western end of the National Academy hall.

units.zh: 十八年東宮始成，十九年正月鵲又巢其西門。
units.en: Crown prince halls drew magpies too.
units.literal: Eighteenth year Eastern Palace finished; nineteenth year first month magpies nested its west gate.

units.zh: 此殆與魏景初同占。
units.en: The parallel was Wei Ming-di's tower nest.
units.literal: This nearly matches Wei Jingchu divination.

units.zh: 學堂，風教所聚；
units.en: The school was the moral heart of state ritual.
units.literal: The academy is where wind-teaching gathers;

units.zh: 西頭，又金行之祥。
units.en: The academy's west eaves matched Jin's metal element.
units.literal: The west end — again an omen of the Metal phase.

units.zh: 及帝崩後，安皇嗣位，桓玄遂篡，風教乃穨，金行不競之象也。
units.en: From Xiaowu's death through An to Xuan, moral education collapsed — Jin metal waning.
units.literal: After the emperor died Prince An succeeded; Huan Xuan then usurped; wind-teaching collapsed — image of metal's line failing.

units.zh: 安帝義熙三年，龍驤將軍硃猗戍壽陽。
units.en: In Yixi 3 under Emperor An, General Zhu Yi was stationed at Shouyang.
units.literal: Emperor An, Yixi 3 — Dragon-Proud General Zhu Yi garrisoned Shouyang.

units.zh: 婢炊飯，忽有群烏集灶，競來啄噉，婢驅遂不去。
units.en: Crows swarmed the camp kitchen fire.
units.literal: A maidservant cooked; suddenly crows massed on the stove competing to peck food; she drove them but they would not go.

units.zh: 有獵狗咋殺兩烏，余烏因共啄殺狗，又噉其肉，唯餘骨存。
units.en: Crows mobbed and devoured the hound.
units.literal: A hunting dog bit two crows; the rest together pecked the dog dead and ate its flesh until only bones remained.

units.zh: 此亦羽蟲之孽，又黑祥也。
units.en: Black-winged strife marked the omen class.
units.literal: This too was feathered calamity, also black omen.

units.zh: 明年六月，猗死，此其應也。
units.en: Zhu Yi died within the year.
units.literal: Next year sixth month Yi died — its answer.

units.en: Divider.
units.literal: (Sectional marker.)

units.zh: 羊禍
units.en: Subsection: ovine portents.
units.literal: Sheep disasters.

units.zh: （分段）
units.en: Divider.
units.literal: (Sectional marker.)

units.zh: 成帝咸和二年五月，司徒王導廄羊生無後足，此羊禍也。
units.en: In the fifth month of Xianhe 2 under Emperor Cheng, one of Wang Dao’s stable sheep was born without hind legs, a sheep disaster.
units.literal: Emperor Cheng, Xianhe 2, fifth month — a sheep in Minister over the Masses Wang Dao’s stable was born without hind legs; this was a sheep disaster.

units.zh: 京房《易傳》曰：「足少者，下不勝任也。」
units.en: Jing Fang says: "Too few feet — those below cannot bear the load."
units.literal: Jing Fang says: "Too few feet — those below cannot bear the load."

units.zh: 明年，蘇峻破京都，導與帝俱幽石頭，僅乃得免，是其應也。
units.en: Su Jun's coup trapped Wang Dao with the boy emperor.
units.literal: Next year Su Jun took the capital; Dao and the emperor were both imprisoned at Stone City, barely escaping — the answer.

units.en: Divider.
units.literal: (Sectional marker.)

units.zh: 赤眚赤祥
units.en: Subsection: scarlet anomalies.
units.literal: Red ill-omens and red signs.

units.zh: （分段）
units.en: Divider.
units.literal: (Sectional marker.)

units.zh: 公孫文懿時，襄平北市生肉，長圍各數尺，有頭目口喙，無手足而動搖，此赤祥也。
units.en: Self-moving meat appeared in Liaodong market.
units.literal: Under Gongsun Wenyi — north market of Xiangping grew flesh several chi long and wide, with head, eyes, and beak, no limbs yet writhing — red omen.

units.zh: 占曰：「有形不成，有體不聲，其國滅亡。」
units.en: Divination says: "Form incomplete, body voiceless — its state will perish."
units.literal: Divination says: "Form incomplete, body voiceless — its state will perish."

units.zh: 文懿尋為魏所誅。
units.en: Wei destroyed Wenyi swiftly.
units.literal: Wenyi was soon executed by Wei.

units.zh: 吳戍將鄧喜殺豬祠神，治畢懸之，忽見一人頭往食肉，喜引弓射中之，咋咋作聲，繞屋三日，近赤祥也。
units.en: A flying head feasted on Deng Xi's offering.
units.literal: Wu garrison commander Deng Xi slaughtered a pig for a shrine; hung it; suddenly a human head came to eat the meat; Xi shot it; it crackled, circling the roof three days — near red omen.

units.zh: 後人白喜謀北叛，闔門被誅。
units.en: Xi's family died for treason.
units.literal: Later men accused Xi of plotting northern rebellion; his whole clan was executed.

units.zh: 京房《易傳》曰：「山見葆，江於邑，邑有兵，狀如人頭，赤色。」
units.en: Jing Fang says: "Mountain shows treasure, river in town, town has arms, shape like human head, red."
units.literal: Jing Fang says: "Mountain shows treasure, river in town, town has arms, shape like human head, red."

units.zh: 武帝太康五年四月壬子，魯國池水變赤如血。
units.en: In Emperor Wu's Taikang 5.4, on renzi, Lu's ponds turned blood-red.
units.literal: In the fourth month of Taikang 5 under Emperor Wu, on renzi day, the pond water in Lu Principality turned red like blood.

units.zh: 七年十月，河陰有赤雪二頃。
units.en: Crimson snow covered Heyin fields.
units.literal: Seventh year tenth month — Heyin had two qing of red snow.

units.zh: 此赤祥也。
units.en: The crimson fall matched chi portents.
units.literal: This was red omen.

units.zh: 是後四載而帝崩，王室遂亂。
units.en: Sima Yan perished; turmoil followed.
units.literal: Four years later the emperor died; the royal house then fell into chaos.

units.zh: 惠帝元康五年三月，呂縣有流血，東西百餘步，此赤祥也。
units.en: In the third month of Yuankang 5 under Emperor Hui, blood flowed across more than a hundred paces of Lü county, a red omen.
units.literal: Emperor Hui, Yuankang 5, third month — there was flowing blood in Lü county, stretching more than a hundred paces east to west; this was a red omen.

units.zh: 至元康末，窮凶極亂，僵屍流血之應也。
units.en: The War of the Eight Princes fulfilled the sign.
units.literal: By late Yuankang utmost villainy and chaos — answer of corpses and flowing blood.

units.zh: 干寶以為「後八載而封雲亂徐州，殺傷數萬人」，是其應也。
units.en: Gan Bao thought: "Eight years later Feng Yun ravaged Xuzhou, killing tens of thousands" — its answer.
units.literal: Gan Bao thought: "Eight years later Feng Yun ravaged Xuzhou, killing tens of thousands" — its answer.

units.zh: 永康元年三月，尉氏雨血。
units.en: In the first year of Yongkang, Blood showered on Weishi.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongkang, third month — Weishi rained blood.

units.zh: 夫政刑舒緩，則有常燠赤祥之妖。
units.en: Lax justice invites thermal and sanguinary signs.
units.literal: When government and punishments are slack there are omens of constant heat and red freaks.

units.zh: 此歲正月，送湣懷太子，幽于許宮。
units.en: In the first month of this year Crown Prince Minhuai was sent to be confined at the Xu palace.
units.literal: That year's first month they escorted Crown Prince Min-Huai, imprisoned him at Xu palace.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，不宜緩恣奸人，將使太子冤死。
units.en: Heaven rebuked Jia Nanfeng's plot against the heir.
units.literal: Heaven warns: do not indulgently trust villains — it will make the heir die wronged.

units.zh: 惠帝愚眊不寤，是月湣懷遂斃。
units.en: Emperor Hui, dull and unawakened, let Minhuai die that month.
units.literal: Emperor Hui was dull and did not wake; that month Min-Huai was murdered.

units.zh: 於是王室成釁，禍流天下。
units.en: Dynastic shame ignited civil war.
units.literal: Thereupon the royal house bore scandal; disaster spread under heaven.

units.zh: 淖齒殺齊湣王日，天雨血沾衣。
units.en: Spring and Autumn parallel: blood rain on regicide.
units.literal: The day Zhuo Chi killed King Min of Qi heaven rained blood staining clothes.

units.zh: 天以告也，此之謂乎？
units.en: The classic blood-rain trope applied.
units.literal: Heaven announces — does it not mean this?

units.zh: 京房《易傳》曰：「歸獄不解，茲謂追非，厥咎天雨血。
units.en: Jing Fang says: "When guilt is not cleared it is called pursuing wrong — its fault heaven rains blood.
units.literal: Jing Fang says: "When guilt is not cleared it is called pursuing wrong — its fault heaven rains blood.

units.zh: 茲謂不親，下有噁心，不出三年，無其宗。」
units.en: This is called unfilial — below is malice — within three years the lineage ends."
units.literal: This is called unfilial — below is malice — within three years the lineage ends."

units.zh: 又曰：「佞人祿，功臣戮，天雨血也。」
units.en: Also: "When sycophants have salary and merit ministers are slaughtered — heaven rains blood."
units.literal: Also: "When sycophants have salary and merit ministers are slaughtered — heaven rains blood."

units.zh: 湣帝建興元年十二月，河東地震，雨肉。
units.en: In Emperor Min's Jianxing 1.12, Hedong shook and meat fell from the sky.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of Jianxing 1 under Emperor Min, Hedong had an earthquake and meat rained down.

units.zh: 四年十二月丙寅，丞相府斬督運令史淳于伯，血逆流上柱二丈三尺，此赤祥也。
units.en: Chunyu Bo's blood defied gravity in the ministry yard.
units.literal: Fourth year twelfth month bingyin — chief minister's office executed transport clerk Chunyu Bo; blood flowed upward two zhang three chi along a pillar — red omen.

units.zh: 是時，後將軍褚裒鎮廣陵，丞相揚聲北伐，伯以督運稽留及役使贓罪，依軍法戮之。
units.en: At this time Rear General Chu Pou guarded Guangling and the chancellor proclaimed a northern campaign; Bo was executed under military law for transport delay and bribery.
units.literal: Then rear general Chu Ai garrisoned Guangling; the chief minister proclaimed northern campaign; Bo was judged for transport delay and embezzled labor — executed by military law.

units.zh: 其息訴稱：「督運事訖，無所稽乏，受賕役使，罪不及死。
units.en: His son appealed: "Transport duty was finished — no delay; bribery and labor charges do not merit death.
units.literal: His son appealed: "Transport duty was finished — no delay; bribery and labor charges do not merit death.

units.zh: 兵家之勢，先聲後實，實是屯戍，非為征軍。
units.en: Military principle is threat before stroke; this was garrison duty, not expedition force.
units.literal: Military principle is threat before stroke; this was garrison duty, not expedition force.

units.zh: 自四年已來，運漕稽停，皆不以軍興法論。」
units.en: Since year four transport halts were never judged by martial law."
units.literal: Since year four transport halts were never judged by martial law."

units.zh: 僚佐莫之理。
units.en: Bureaucrats ignored the plea.
units.literal: Staff would not hear him.

units.zh: 及有變，司直彈劾眾官，元帝不問，遂頻旱三年。
units.en: Sima Rui's inaction brought triple drought.
units.literal: When the anomaly came rectifiers impeached many officials; Yuan-di did not inquire — drought followed three years.

units.zh: 干寶以為冤氣之應也。
units.en: Gan Bao called it unjust-death weather.
units.literal: Gan Bao thought it answered wrongful qi.

units.zh: 郭景純曰：「血者水類，同屬於《坎》。
units.en: Guo Pu said: "Blood is water-class; it belongs to Kan.
units.literal: Guo Pu said: "Blood is water-class; it belongs to Kan.

units.zh: 《坎》為法象，水準潤下，不宜逆流。
units.en: Kan is the image of law; water should moisten downward — it must not flow upward.
units.literal: Kan is the image of law; water should moisten downward — it must not flow upward.

units.zh: 此政有咎失之征也。」
units.en: This is a sign that government errs."
units.literal: This is a sign that government errs."

units.zh: 劉聰偽建元元年正月，平陽地震，其崇明觀陷為池，水赤如血，赤氣至天，有赤龍奮迅而去。
units.en: In the first month of Liu Cong's illegitimate first year of Jianyuan, Pingyang shook, Chongming Observatory collapsed into a blood-red pool, red vapor rose to the sky, and a red dragon surged away.
units.literal: In the first month of Liu Cong's illegitimate Jianyuan 1, an earthquake struck Pingyang; its Chongming Observatory sank into a pool, the water was red as blood, red vapor reached the sky, and a red dragon surged away.

units.zh: 流星起於牽牛，入紫微，龍形委蛇，其光照地，落於平陽北十里。
units.en: A draconic meteor fell north of Pingyang.
units.literal: A shooting star rose from Ox, entered Purple Palace, dragon-shaped writhing, light shining on earth, fell ten li north of Pingyang.

units.zh: 視之則肉，臭聞於平陽。
units.en: The "meteor" was rotting meat.
units.literal: Viewed closely it was flesh; stench filled Pingyang.

units.zh: 長三十步，廣二十七步。
units.en: The carcass spanned thirty by twenty-seven paces.
units.literal: Thirty paces long, twenty-seven wide.

units.zh: 肉旁常有哭聲，晝夜不止。
units.en: Wails rose from the meteoric flesh.
units.literal: Beside the meat crying was often heard day and night without cease.

units.zh: 數日，聰后劉氏產一蛇一獸，各害人而走。
units.en: Empress Liu whelped man-eating monsters.
units.literal: Several days later Cong's empress Liu bore a snake and a beast; each killed people and fled.

units.zh: 尋之不得，頃之見於隕肉之旁。
units.en: The creatures haunted the flesh-mound.
units.literal: Seekers could not find them; soon they appeared beside the fallen meat.

units.zh: 是時，劉聰納劉殷三女，並為其后。
units.en: Liu Cong stacked three Liu brides.
units.literal: Then Liu Cong took three daughters of Liu Yin as empresses together.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，聰既自稱劉姓，三后又俱劉氏，逆骨肉之綱，成人倫之則。
units.en: Incestuous Liu matches drew Heaven's rebuke.
units.literal: Heaven warns: Cong already claimed the Liu surname; three empresses also Liu — he violated flesh-and-bone ethics, broke human relations.

units.zh: 隕肉諸妖，其眚亦大。
units.en: The prodigies compounded.
units.literal: The fallen meat and many portents — the ill-omen was great.

units.zh: 俄而劉氏死，哭聲自絕矣。
units.en: When the empresses perished the keening stopped.
units.literal: Soon the Liu ladies died and the crying ceased.
